payload.name: Socialinsider
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Socialinsider is a social media analytics plugin for marketers, social media managers, agencies and analysts. Its main purpose is to retrieve and analyze performance data from profiles tracked in your Socialinsider account.

Analyze Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and X: summarize follower growth and engagement, compare tracked competitors on the same network, identify top-performing posts, inspect post formats, and report campaign results using existing campaign tags. Use the profile-audit, competitor-benchmark and campaign-recap skills for repeatable reports.

You can also list projects, profiles, brands and campaign tags. Optional account-management tools let you track a profile, organize it into a brand, create projects or brands, and remove tracked profiles or brands. The assistant describes the exact change and requests confirmation before each write action.

Requirements and limitations: an existing Socialinsider account with analytics access is required. Available history and metrics vary by network and profile permissions. Requests outside the permitted history return an error; use a shorter supported date range. Newly tracked profiles need time for data collection. Campaign reports require existing campaign tags. Instagram Stories require an owned, connected business account. The plugin cannot publish social posts, read private messages or retrieve another account's private workspace data.

Goodie shows you how AI talks about your brand across 12 leading AI surfaces including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Mode, in every country, language, and persona that matters, then helps you close the gaps and measure the revenue impact.

The Goodie MCP connector brings that loop into Claude:
- Research — the prompts your market is actually running, and who's already cited
- Monitor — visibility score, share of voice, sentiment, citations, and competitor benchmarking across models and regions
- Actions — prioritized recommendations across technical, owned content, earned outreach, and social
- Measure — AI-driven sessions, conversions, revenue attribution, and which AI crawlers are hitting your site
- Commerce — product and merchant visibility in AI shopping answers

Goodie's data is AEO-native — built specifically for the answer engine layer, not repurposed from traditional SEO tools.

Goodie's in-platform agent is your specialized AEO strategist; the MCP connector lets Claude reference your Goodie data wherever you already work.
payload.longDescription:

- 行动 —— 技术、自有内容、获得的推广和社交领域的优先建议
- 测量 —— AI驱动的会话、转化率、收入归因，以及哪些AI爬虫正在访问您的网站
- 电商 —— 产品和商家在AI购物答案中的可见性

Goodie的数据是AEO原生的——专为答案引擎层设计，而非传统SEO工具的改造版本。

payload.name: CueScout
payload.description: 检查AI是否在回答中提及您的品牌
payload.summaryOriginal: Check if AI answers name you
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CueScout checks how AI answer engines treat a website.

Ask whether an AI search engine names your brand for a question a buyer would type, and CueScout runs that question once and reports back: whether the brand was named, whether its site was cited, which of up to three competitors came up, and the pages the answer was built from. Those pages are mostly reviews, comparison posts and "best tools" lists on other people's sites, so the list tells you where the answer is coming from.

Four more checks look at the site itself and use no AI. One reads robots.txt and says whether the main AI crawlers are blocked, including by a catch-all rule nobody meant to write. Another runs eight readiness checks: crawler access, llms.txt, Organization and FAQ schema, canonical and meta tags, whether the copy is in the HTML or only appears after JavaScript runs, and whether there is an about page and a pricing page. The last two validate the JSON-LD on a single page and check that the sitemap can be fetched, parses, and is listed in robots.txt.

If you track brands in CueScout, you can connect your account and ask about them directly. The app then reads what CueScout has already collected: how often AI answers named your brand and each competitor, your share of voice, the prompts you're missing from and who got named instead, what each engine actually said, the pages those answers cited, your To-dos in priority order, and your last site audit. Connecting is read only. The app can't change settings, add prompts, run checks or buy anything, and you can disconnect it in CueScout's settings.

It's built for marketers, founders and SEO people who want a quick read on AI search in the middle of a conversation. The five checks above work without an account.

What it can't tell you: the visibility check asks an engine through its search API, not through a consumer app, so no account history, memory or location shapes the answer. One question gives one answer. A brand missing from one phrasing can show up in the next, so read a single result as one datapoint rather than a score. The site checks only read public pages and never change anything. Visibility checks have a daily limit shared by everyone using the app.
payload.longDescription:
CueScout会检查AI回答引擎如何处理您的网站。

您可以询问AI搜索引擎是否会将您的品牌作为买家搜索问题的答案，CueScout会运行该问题一次并返回结果：品牌是否被提及、网站是否被引用、最多三个竞争对手中哪个出现、以及答案来源的页面。这些页面主要是其他网站上的评论、对比文章和「最佳工具」列表，因此该列表会显示答案的来源。

四项额外检查直接针对网站本身且不使用AI。一项会读取robots.txt文件并显示主要AI爬虫是否被阻止，包括那些无意中被写入的全局限制规则。另一项会执行八项就绪检查：爬虫访问权限、llms.txt文件、组织结构和FAQ结构数据、规范标签和元标签、内容是否直接存在于HTML中而非仅在JavaScript运行后出现，以及是否包含关于页面和定价页面。最后两项会验证单页的JSON-LD有效性，并检查站点地图是否可获取、可解析且列在robots.txt中。

如果您在CueScout中跟踪品牌，可以连接账户并直接查询这些品牌。应用会读取CueScout已收集的信息：AI回答中提及您的品牌及每个竞争对手的频率、您的品牌曝光度占比、您错过的提示词以及被提及的替代品牌、各搜索引擎实际返回的内容、答案引用的页面、按优先级排序的待办事项清单，以及最近的网站审计记录。连接操作为只读模式。应用无法更改设置、添加提示词、执行检查或购买任何东西，您可以在CueScout的设置中随时断开连接。

该工具专为需要在对话中快速了解AI搜索情况的营销人员、创始人和SEO人员设计。上述五项检查无需账户即可使用。

它无法告知您：可见性检查通过搜索引擎的搜索API提问，而非通过消费者应用，因此不会受账户历史记录、记忆或位置影响。一个问题仅提供一个答案。某个品牌可能在一种表述中未出现，但在下一种表述中出现，因此请将单个结果视为一个数据点而非评分。网站检查仅读取公开页面且永远不会修改任何内容。可见性检查存在每日限额，所有用户共享该限额。

payload.name: Reckon
payload.description: 为什么你的广告会胜出或失败
payload.summaryOriginal: Why your ads win or lose
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ad dashboards tell you which ad won. Reckon tells you why.

Reckon reads every video and image you run on Meta and Google and tags what is inside it: the spoken hook, the angle, the claims, the format, the call to action and the full transcript. Then it ties each of those to what the ad spent and earned, so you can ask which hooks and angles actually sell, and get an answer from your own ads rather than best practice.

It does the same for your competitors. Reckon tracks the brands you name in the Meta Ad Library and tags their ads the same way as yours, so you can see the angles they run that you do not, which of their ads they keep running, and where the market is crowded or empty.

What you can ask:
- Which hooks, angles and formats cost least per result in our own ads?
- What do our best ads have in common, and where do viewers drop off in our videos?
- What are competitors saying that we are not? Give me test candidates.
- Which ads should we cut or scale? Every ad is judged against the other ads selling the same product, with the evidence behind each call.

Meta and Google come back in one answer. Anything that cannot be added together, such as two currencies, is named rather than summed.

Reckon does the analysis; ChatGPT does the talking. Every figure comes from Reckon's stored analysis.

Read-only by design. Reckon never changes an ad account: it cannot pause an ad, move a budget or publish anything. Its only writes are to Reckon itself (logging a creative test, sending feedback, fetching a Meta Ad Library ad you share), and ChatGPT asks before each one.

Requires a Reckon workspace with a Meta or Google Ads account connected by an admin at usereckon.ai. Access is to the one workspace chosen at sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
广告仪表盘告诉你哪则广告胜出，Reckon告诉你原因。

Reckon会分析你在Meta和Google上投放的所有视频和图片，并标记其中内容：包括口头钩子、叙事角度、核心主张、内容形式、行动呼吁以及完整字幕。然后将这些元素与广告的投入和收益关联起来，你可以提问哪些钩子和角度真正促进销售，答案来自你自己的广告数据，而非通用准则。

Reckon同样会分析竞争对手。通过追踪你在Meta广告库中指定的品牌，以相同方式标记他们的广告，你可以看到他们采用而你未使用的角度，了解他们持续投放的广告，以及市场中哪些领域竞争激烈或存在空白。

你可以提出的问题包括：
- 哪些钩子、角度和形式在我们的广告中每结果成本最低？
- 我们表现最佳的广告有哪些共同点？观众在视频哪个环节流失？
- 竞争对手在强调什么而我们没有？请提供测试候选广告。
- 哪些广告需要停投或扩大规模？
每则广告都会与同产品竞品广告进行对比，每个行动呼吁都有数据支撑。

Meta和Google的数据会整合到单一报告中。无法直接相加的内容（如两种货币）会以命名方式呈现而非数值汇总。

Reckon负责数据分析，ChatGPT负责生成解释。所有数据均来自Reckon存储的分析结果。

设计为只读模式。Reckon不会修改任何广告账户：无法暂停广告、调整预算或发布内容。其唯一写入操作仅限于自身系统（如记录创意测试、发送反馈、获取你分享的Meta广告库广告），且每次操作前都会向ChatGPT确认。

需要拥有由usereckon.ai管理员连接的Meta或Google Ads账户的Reckon工作区。访问权限仅限于注册时选择的工作区。

Klar connects your ecommerce store, marketing channels and costs in one place. This plugin lets you ask questions about that data in plain language and get answers from your own Klar reports.

Who it is for: ecommerce founders, marketers, performance and finance teams who already use Klar.

跨日期范围对比展示次数、覆盖范围、完成观看次数、访问量、转化率及每次访问成本，按活动或创意分解结果，将连接电视数据转化为清晰报告并查看预算的投入效果

payload.name: Product Information API
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Retrieve product facts and save an account watchlist of Amazon ASINs by marketplace. View availability with its original observation time and subscribe to changes in ChatGPT. Watches use existing public stock observations, start no extra checks and charge no watch credits; observation gaps and intermediate changes can be missed. Size, colour and variant identity remain unknown unless established by source data. Product-information requests use your account allowance. This plugin does not change inventory or listings.
payload.longDescription: 获取产品信息并按市场保存亚马逊ASIN的账户监控列表。查看可用性及原始观察时间，并通过ChatGPT订阅变更通知。监控功能使用现有公开库存观察数据，不会启动额外检查，也不会消耗监控积分；可能遗漏观察间隔期和中间变化。尺寸、颜色和变体身份信息在源数据未明确的情况下仍无法确定。产品信息请求会消耗您的账户配额。此插件不会修改库存或商品信息。

payload.name: Pricewatcha
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Pricewatcha is a price-data plugin for ChatGPT. Its main purpose is product price analytics: search a structured catalog, inspect current and historical prices, and surface lows, highs, averages, and trends so you can decide whether a price looks good. You can also submit a public merchant product URL for tracking, manage a watchlist, and create price alerts. Catalog and history reads work without an account; alert and watchlist tools require a Pricewatcha API key.
payload.longDescription: Pricewatcha是专为ChatGPT设计的价格数据插件。其主要功能是产品价格分析：可搜索结构化目录、查看当前及历史价格，并展示低点、高点、平均值和趋势，帮助判断价格是否合理。您还可以提交公开商家产品网址进行追踪，管理看板列表并创建价格警报。目录和历史记录读取无需账户；警报和看板工具需要Pricewatcha API密钥。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Analyze historical price lows, highs, averages, and trends, Search the Pricewatcha product price catalog, Track a merchant product URL to collect price data, Create watchlists and price-change alerts

payload.name: Adzviser PageSpeed Insights
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect Google PageSpeed Insights to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how fast your pages load and what is holding them back.

Compare performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO scores alongside Core Web Vitals such as Largest Contentful Paint, Cumulative Layout Shift, and Interaction to Next Paint. Break results down by page and by mobile or desktop. Turn your speed data into clear reports and see which pages need attention first.
payload.longDescription:
使用Adzviser将Google PageSpeed Insights连接到ChatGPT，用简单明了的语言提问，查看您的页面加载速度以及是什么在阻碍它们。

将性能、可访问性、最佳实践和SEO评分与核心网页指标（如最大内容绘制、累计布局偏移和到下一个响应的交互）进行对比。按页面或移动设备/桌面分解结果，将您的速度数据转化为清晰报告，优先查看需要关注的页面。

payload.name: Geckoboard
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Access business metrics from Geckoboard directly in ChatGPT. Query up-to-date metrics from Zendesk, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Intercom, Aircall, Google Analytics, and more, without exporting records or calculating metrics by hand. Use the data to analyse performance, investigate changes, and create reports.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中直接访问Geckoboard的业务指标。无需导出记录或手动计算指标，即可查询Zendesk、HubSpot、Pipedrive、Intercom、Aircall、Google Analytics等平台的最新数据指标。使用这些数据分析绩效、调查变化并生成报告。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Query business metrics, Explore connected data, Retrieve data lists

payload.name: Orgvue EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Orgvue is the organizational design and workforce planning platform used by enterprises to model, cost and reshape their organizations. Connect OpenAI to Orgvue to explore workforce data, organizational structures, and planning scenarios.

In plain, natural language, ask questions about your workforce data: spans and layers, headcount by function, cost of a proposed structure, the gap between your current and future-state organization, or anything else you might want to know.

Ask workforce modelling questions and see the changes happening directly in Orgvue. You’ll get trusted answers grounded in your Orgvue data. See the impact of a scenario before you commit, draft the narrative for a restructure paper, or quickly pull the numbers you need for a board meeting.

Access follows your existing Orgvue permissions. OpenAI sees only the workspaces and datasets you're already entitled to, and only when you ask.

Orgvue remains the trusted source of workforce data and organizational scenarios, while OpenAI provides a conversational way to interact with them.

What you can do:
- Query datasets and properties across your Orgvue workspaces
- Summarize org structures - reporting lines, spans, layers, vacancies
- Ask the agent workforce modelling questions and instantly visualise the impact of changes in Orgvue
- Pull metrics and aggregations for reports, papers and presentations
- Explain what a dataset contains before you dig into it
payload.longDescription:
Orgvue是企业用于组织设计和员工规划的平台，可对组织进行建模、成本核算和重塑。将OpenAI连接到Orgvue，以探索员工数据、组织结构和规划场景。

用简单自然的语言提问关于员工数据的问题：管理幅度和层级、按职能的人数、拟议结构的成本、当前组织与未来组织之间的差距，或您可能想了解的任何其他内容。

提出员工建模问题并直接在Orgvue中查看变化。您将获得基于您Orgvue数据的可信答案。在做出承诺前查看情景影响，起草重组方案的叙述，或快速提取董事会会议所需的数字。

访问权限遵循您现有的Orgvue权限。OpenAI仅能看到您已有权限的工作区和数据集，并且仅在您主动请求时可见。

Orgvue仍然是员工数据和组织情景的可信来源，而OpenAI则提供了一种对话式交互方式。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 跨您的Orgvue工作区查询数据集和属性
- 汇总组织结构——汇报关系、管理幅度、层级和空缺职位
- 向智能体提出员工建模问题并即时在Orgvue中可视化变化影响
- 提取指标和汇总数据用于报告、文件和演示
- 在深入分析前解释数据集内容

payload.name: Docteur Bet
payload.longDescription:
Docteur Bet将足球统计数据整合至ChatGPT。您可以询问某场比赛、联赛争冠形势或球队状态，系统将基于已发表的Dixon-Coles模型（Dixon & Coles, 1997）计算胜率，每轮赛后重新计算，覆盖21项赛事：英超、西甲、意甲、德甲、法甲、三个二级联赛、其他欧洲联赛、欧冠和欧联杯。

您可以查询：
• 单场比赛胜率：主胜/平局/客胜概率、进球数、两队均进球可能性及最可能的比分结果，包含预期进球数及双方攻防强度数据；
• 联赛赛季预测：每支球队夺冠、获得欧战资格或降级概率，以及积分预测，基于数以万计的模拟赛季计算；
• 实力排名：哪些球队实际实力强于或弱于其联赛排名；
• 各赛事赛程安排及对应胜率。

系统可识别球队昵称（如"PSG"、"曼城"、"巴塞罗那"）。所有回答均会标注模型名称、计算日期并附来源页面链接。纯只读模式，无需账户与个人数据。

payload.name: RankZero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RankZero measures how visible a brand is in AI search: how often AI assistants and AI search engines mention it when they answer the questions its customers ask, how it ranks against competitors, and which websites those answers cite. This plugin connects to your RankZero account so you can analyze that data in a conversation. Ask for a brand's visibility percentage and rank over the last 24 hours, 7, 30 or 90 days, see which competitors are mentioned alongside it, review recent AI answers to your tracked prompts, list the most-cited sources, and query the brand's connected Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data. The plugin only reads data and only sees the brands your RankZero account owns or shares through its organization. A RankZero account is required.
payload.longDescription:
RankZero可衡量品牌在AI搜索中的可见度——即当AI助手和AI搜索引擎回答客户问题时，它们提及该品牌的具体频率、品牌在竞争者中的排名情况，以及这些回答引用了哪些网站。
此插件可连接至您的RankZero账户，从而在对话中分析该数据。
您可以查询品牌在过去24小时、7天、30天或90天内的可见度百分比和排名，查看与品牌一同被提及的竞争者，查阅最近AI对跟踪提示的回答，列出被引用最多的来源，并查询品牌连接的Google Analytics 4和Google Search Console数据。
该插件仅读取数据，且仅能看到您的RankZero账户所有或通过组织共享的品牌。
需要拥有RankZero账户。

payload.name: Searcherries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Searcherries gives your AI agent all the data it needs for GEO and SEO in one connection: how AI assistants answer your customers' questions about your market, plus your Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4 data.

Connect Searcherries once and ask in plain language. The agent can build a prioritized action plan, find the questions where AI answers leave your brand out and see which competitors and sources they rely on instead, spot the pages and search queries with the most growth potential, and check how much traffic AI assistants send to your site and where it lands. When the agent can work with your website's code, the included skill turns these findings into concrete page changes and edits the files once you approve them.

Built for founders, marketers and SEO specialists who want their site recommended in AI answers and found in search.

Limitations: you need a Searcherries account with at least one project, and Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4 data appear only for the sources you connect in Searcherries. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot change projects, questions or settings, and it returns the results of Searcherries' scheduled checks rather than running new ones. It only sees the projects of the account you authorize.
payload.longDescription:
Searcherries通过单一连接为您的AI代理提供GEO和SEO所需的所有数据：AI助手如何回答客户关于您所在市场的问题，以及您的Google搜索控制台、必应网页管理员工具和GA4数据。

只需连接一次Searcherries，即可用自然语言提问。
该代理可以制定优先行动方案，发现AI答案中遗漏品牌的问题，查看竞争对手和来源的依赖情况，识别具有最大增长潜力的页面和搜索查询，并检查AI助手为您网站带来的流量及流量来源页面。
当代理可以操作您网站的代码时，内置功能会将这些发现转化为具体的页面修改，并在您批准后编辑文件。

专为希望网站出现在AI答案中并被搜索引擎收录的创始人、营销人员和SEO专家打造。

限制条件：您需要拥有至少包含一个项目的Searcherries账户，且只有在Searcherries中连接的来源才会显示Search Console、必应网页管理员工具和GA4数据。
访问权限为只读：该插件无法修改项目、问题或设置，且仅返回Searcherries的定期检查结果，而非执行新检查。
它仅可见您授权账户的项目。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Build a prioritized GEO and SEO action plan, Read AI visibility metrics, Read stored AI answers and their judgments, Read competitors and sources named in AI answers, Read Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools data, Read GA4 traffic from AI assistants, Propose page changes based on the data

payload.name: MentionedOn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Use MentionedOn's deterministic tools to score supplied discovery signals, prioritize visibility improvements, and summarize dated scan captures without claiming live inclusion.
payload.longDescription: 使用MentionedOn的确定性工具对提供的发现信号进行评分，优先提升可见性改进，并总结过时的扫描捕获，而不声称实时包含。

payload.name: Hercules Real Estate Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hercules Real Estate Data is a property research tool for real estate investors. It answers questions about properties, owners and investors in the United States, using public records and licensed property data, in plain language inside ChatGPT.

Use it to search property records nationwide, look up who owns a property, see who is behind an LLC, find NYC pre-foreclosures and distressed properties, and find active real estate investors and lenders in any market. It is built for investors, acquisitions teams, wholesalers, lenders and agents.

What you can do
- Property search and property records, anywhere in the United States: filter by city, county, zip code, property type, equity, absentee owners, vacant properties and more.
- Owner lookup: the owner of record, owner type, mailing address, how long they have owned it, and whether the property is owner-occupied or absentee-owned.
- Property details: estimated value and equity, mortgage and lender, last sale date, beds, baths, square footage and building details.
- NYC pre-foreclosure and foreclosure data: lis pendens filings by borough, foreclosure stage, equity, filing age and recently added cases.
- LLC owner lookup: find the officers, managers and registered agent behind an LLC or company that owns property, from public business filings.
- Active investors: see who is buying in an area, including cash buyers, portfolio owners and corporate buyers, grouped by owner with recent purchase counts.
- Investor and lender firm search: hard money lenders, private lenders, note buyers, fix-and-flip investors, real estate funds and wholesalers, with business phone numbers, business emails and websites.

Before a large search runs, you see how many records match and get suggestions for narrowing it. Nothing runs until you confirm.

What it does not do
- It does not provide personal phone numbers or personal email addresses.
- It covers properties in the United States only.
- A Hercules account is required.

Try asking
- "Find absentee-owned single-family homes in Tampa with at least 40% equity."
- "Show me NYC pre-foreclosures in Brooklyn added in the last 30 days."
- "Who owns 123 Main Street in Austin, Texas?"
- "Who is behind Lennar Homes, LLC in Florida?"
- "Who is buying multifamily properties in Miami?"
- "Find hard money lenders in Phoenix."

Results are provided for research and may be incomplete or out of date. Verify before relying on them. See the privacy policy and terms for details.
payload.longDescription:
Hercules Real Estate Data是房地产投资者的房产研究工具。它通过ChatGPT以自然语言回答美国房产、所有者和投资者相关问题，数据来源包括公开记录和授权房产数据。

您可以 nationwide 搜索房产记录，查询房产所有者信息，查看LLC背后的公司实体，查找纽约市预法拍房和 distressed properties（困境房产），以及发现任何市场中的活跃房地产投资者和贷款机构。该工具专为投资者、收购团队、二手房商、贷款机构和经纪人设计。

您可以实现的功能包括
- 全美范围的房产搜索与记录查询：支持按城市、县、邮编、房产类型、净值、非居住所有者、空置房产等条件筛选。
- 所有者信息查询：记录所有者类型、邮寄地址、持有时长，以及房产是否为自住或非居住所有。
- 房产详情：预估价值与净值、抵押贷款及贷款机构、最近售出日期、房间数、浴室数、建筑面积和建筑详情。
- 纽约市预法拍与法拍数据：按行政区划分的诉讼中文件（lis pendens）记录、法拍阶段、净值、文件年龄和近期新增案件。
- LLC所有者信息查询：通过公开企业文件，查找拥有房产的LLC或公司的高管、管理人员和注册代理人。
- 活跃投资者信息：查看某个区域的买家信息，包括现金买家、组合持有者和企业买家，按所有者分组显示最近购买次数。
- 投资者与贷款机构搜索：提供硬钱贷款机构、私人贷款商、票据买家、翻新投资者、房地产基金和二手房商信息，包含企业电话、企业邮箱和官网链接。

在执行大型搜索前，您会看到匹配的记录数量，并获得缩小范围的建议。在您确认前不会执行任何操作。

该工具不提供以下内容
- 不提供个人电话号码或个人电子邮件地址。
- 仅覆盖美国境内的房产。
- 需要Hercules账户才能使用。

可以尝试提问
- "查找坦帕市至少40%净值的非居住独栋住宅。"
- "显示最近30天新增的布鲁克林区纽约市预法拍房。"
- "谁拥有德克萨斯州奥斯汀市123 Main Street的房产？"
- "佛罗里达州Lennar Homes, LLC背后的公司实体是谁？"
- "谁在迈阿密购买多户住宅？"
- "查找凤凰城的硬钱贷款机构。"

查询结果仅用于研究目的，可能不完整或已过时。在依赖结果前请自行核实。详情请查看隐私政策和使用条款。

payload.name: Supersimple
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Answer complex business questions across your data warehouse and internal tools, on top of governed definitions and metrics. Explore saved analyses, update reusable data apps, and get cited answers with interactive charts. Improve future answers by managing AI context and learnings from your team's real-world questions and feedback.
payload.longDescription:
在您的数据仓库和内部工具中回答复杂的业务问题，基于合规的定义和指标。
探索已保存的分析，更新可重复使用的数据应用，并通过交互式图表获得可引用的答案。
通过管理AI上下文以及从团队的实际问题和反馈中学习，提升未来回答的质量。

payload.name: Framework
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Framework by NewForm helps marketing teams analyze advertising creative. Request an Ad Atlas for the brand associated with your verified company email, subject to company and shared capacity limits. After confirmation and privacy acceptance, Framework processes public ad-library data into a creative map, format mix, coverage notes and findings. Explore saved reports in an interactive view where supported, with a text summary elsewhere. Connect an existing Framework account to compare advertising performance and review creative tests within its current access permissions. Report reads reuse saved analysis. Ad launching, budget changes, Drive access and report refreshes are unavailable.
payload.longDescription: NewForm推出的Framework帮助营销团队分析广告创意。通过已验证的企业邮箱申请关联品牌的Ad Atlas，具体以公司及共享容量限制为准。确认并接受隐私政策后，Framework会将公共广告库数据转化为创意图谱、格式组合、覆盖说明及分析结论。在支持交互式视图的场景中可探索已保存报告，其他场景提供文本摘要。连接现有Framework账户可对比广告表现并在当前访问权限内查看创意测试记录。报告阅读功能可重复使用已保存的分析结果。广告发布、预算调整、Drive访问和报告刷新功能不可用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Ad Atlas generation, Interactive Atlas reports, Creative analytics, Creative test review

payload.name: Sun Hours for Solar Panels
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Compare monthly sunlight data and calculate annual solar energy potential using NASA POWER historical averages. Choose a location, adjust system size and losses, and compare the seasons. Results are a rough horizontal-sunlight baseline; roof angle, local shading and actual meter output are not modelled. No inverter account is connected.
payload.longDescription: 对比月度日照数据并使用NASA POWER历史平均值计算年度太阳能发电潜力。选择一个地点，调整系统规模和损耗，并进行季节对比。结果仅为水平面日照的粗略基准；未考虑屋顶角度、局部遮挡和实际电表输出。未连接逆变器账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Seasonal solar potential, Monthly comparison, System-size estimates

payload.name: Jet Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jet Tracker brings Brazilian business aviation data into ChatGPT. Ask about any Brazilian-registered aircraft and get the official registry record (RAB/ANAC), the owner set with the company record from the Receita Federal, airworthiness validity, tracked flight activity (ADS-B/FR24), overnight base, market listings and certified maintenance shops (ANAC RBAC 145), with US (FAA) and worldwide (GAMA) context.

Built for aircraft brokers, maintenance shops, lessors and analysts: find who owns a tail, list aircraft by model, state or owner city, see which aircraft landed at an airport, and follow registry changes.

Every number carries a source and an as-of date. A registry change is never called a sale, missing tracking is never called "does not fly", and personal tax IDs are never returned.
payload.longDescription:
Jet Tracker将巴西商务航空数据引入ChatGPT。询问任何注册的巴西飞机，即可获取官方注册记录（RAB/ANAC）、与公司记录关联的所有者信息（来自巴西国家税务署Receita Federal）、适航有效性、飞行活动记录（ADS-B/FR24）、过夜基地、市场挂牌信息以及经认证的维修厂（ANAC RBAC 145），并提供美国（FAA）和全球（GAMA）背景信息。

专为飞机经纪人、维修厂、出租方和分析师设计：可查询尾号所有者信息，按机型、州或所有者城市列出飞机，查看哪些飞机在机场降落，并跟踪注册信息变更。

每个数据条目都标明了来源和更新日期。注册信息变更从不被称为销售，飞行轨迹缺失从不解释为「未飞行」，且不会返回个人税号。

payload.name: Home
payload.summaryOriginal: UK homes for sale and to rent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Home finds homes for sale and to rent across the United Kingdom from home.co.uk, right in the conversation. Describe what you want in your own words: a town, city or postcode, buying or renting, your budget, how many bedrooms, new build or not, newest or lowest price first, and what you want in the home itself, such as a garden, off-road parking, a quiet street, period features, open-plan living, a home office or no onward chain. Home shows the matching houses and flats as photo cards and a map, with asking price or rent, bedrooms, tenure, the date each one was added, how long it has been on the market, whether it has been reduced or gone under offer, and the listing's own words for each feature you asked about.

Open any result for the full picture in chat: every photo, the complete description, the agent, key facts and, where the published address can be matched to a property, checks from Homedata such as the EPC energy rating, council tax band, flood and other environmental risks, broadband, nearby schools and recorded crime. Keep a shortlist and compare two to four homes side by side. See which homes are within a walk, cycle or drive of a station, office, school or postcode, and put up to six viewings in the quickest driving order for the day. Ask what an area is like for schools, broadband, recorded crime and local house price growth, see recent sold prices and typical rents nearby, find local estate and letting agents, and estimate stamp duty or monthly mortgage repayments from your own figures.

Home also brings five workflows: what can I afford, turning a monthly budget and deposit into a price and the homes at it; prepare for a viewing, with a checklist and questions for the agent built from the home's own details; plan a viewing day, with the order, the driving between stops and what to ask at each; shortlist and compare, ranking homes against what matters to you, commute included; and buying costs, setting out stamp duty, deposit, loan and monthly repayments together.

It is for anyone house hunting: first-time buyers, movers, renters and families comparing places to live. Searching, viewing property details, comparing homes and using the planning and calculator tools need no account.

Limitations: Home does not value homes or forecast prices, list a home, contact agents for you, or decide mortgage eligibility. Calculator results are estimates, not tax or financial advice, and stamp duty covers England and Northern Ireland. Commute and driving times are typical estimates, not timetables or live traffic. Availability and status are snapshots from the time of the search.
payload.longDescription:
Home在对话中直接从home.co.uk提供全英范围内的房产出售和租赁信息。用您自己的话描述需求：城市、城镇或邮编，购房或租房，预算范围，房间数量，是否新房，按最新上架或最低价格排序，以及您关注的房屋特征，例如带花园、户外停车、安静街道、历史建筑特色、开放式布局、家庭办公室或无后续交易链。Home以图文卡片和地图形式展示匹配的房源，显示报价或租金、房间数、产权类型、上架日期、挂牌时长、是否降价或已报价，以及房源详情中与您需求相关的各项特征描述。

点击任意结果查看完整房源信息：所有照片、完整描述、中介信息、关键数据，当发布地址可匹配具体房产时，还可查看Homedata提供的检查信息，包括能源效率评级、市政税等级、洪水及其他环境风险、宽带速度、周边学校和犯罪记录。可创建精选列表并同时对比2-4处房产。查看哪些房源位于车站、办公室、学校或邮编区域的步行、骑行或驾车范围内，并按最快驾驶顺序安排最多6次看房。询问某个区域的学校、宽带、犯罪记录及房价增长情况，查看周边近期成交价和典型租金，查找当地房产和租赁中介，并根据自身数据估算印花税或月供还款额。

Home提供五大工作流：1）我负担得起什么：将月预算和首付转换为可购房价及对应房源；2）看房准备：根据房源信息自动生成检查清单和中介提问指南；3）看房日规划：包含行程顺序、各站点间驾驶路线及每个房源的提问清单；4）精选对比：根据您关注的要素（含通勤时间）对房源进行排序；5）购房成本：整合展示印花税、首付、贷款及月供还款明细。

Home适用于所有寻房人群：首次购房者、搬迁者、租房者及对比居住地的家庭。搜索、查看房源详情、对比房产及使用规划和计算器工具均无需账户。

限制条件：Home不提供房产估值或价格预测，不发布房源，不代您联系中介，也不判定房贷资格。计算器结果为估算值，不构成税务或财务建议，印花税仅适用于英格兰和北爱尔兰。通勤及驾驶时间均为常规预估，非时刻表或实时路况。可用性和状态仅为搜索时的快照信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search UK homes for sale and to rent, Search by garden, parking, quiet street and more, Every photo and the full description of a home, Time on market, price reductions and under-offer dates, Compare two to four homes side by side, Homes within a walk, cycle or drive of a place, Plan the quickest order for a day of viewings, Area checks: schools, broadband, crime, price growth, Stamp duty, mortgage and affordability estimates

payload.name: Perigon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Perigon helps analysts and researchers search, filter and analyze global news data. Search articles and stories by sentiment, journalist, publisher location, company, topic, language and date. Combine filters to find precise coverage, compare trends and produce briefings with source citations.

Create monitors that track matching news and extract structured fields for analysis. Example requests:
• Create a monitor for AI startups raising a Series A. Extract funding value, industry, funding type and status.
• Create a monitor for mentions of my brand in Perigon news coverage, with a sentiment breakdown.
• Create a monitor for cybersecurity incidents in the financial sector. Extract severity, incident type, data exposure and affected companies.

Explore monitor events and newsletters, then analyze results with Signal Insights exports and charts. New monitors default to drafts unless you ask to activate them. Brand monitoring requires your brand name and any relevant aliases; coverage depends on available sources and your filters.

Connect your Perigon account through OAuth. Available tools and data depend on your organization permissions.
payload.longDescription:
Perigon帮助分析师和研究人员搜索、过滤并分析全球新闻数据。通过情感、记者、发布者所在地区、公司、主题、语言和日期等条件搜索文章和新闻故事。组合筛选条件以找到精确的报道，对比趋势并生成带来源引用的简报。

创建可追踪匹配新闻的监控项，并提取结构化字段用于分析。示例请求：• 为获得A轮融资的AI初创公司创建监控项，提取融资金额、行业、融资类型和状态。• 为Perigon新闻报道中提及的品牌创建监控项，并提供情感分析。• 为金融行业的网络安全事件创建监控项，提取严重程度、事件类型、数据泄露情况和受影响公司。

查看监控事件和新闻简报，然后通过Signal Insights导出数据和图表分析结果。新监控项默认保存为草稿，除非您主动要求激活。品牌监控需要提供您的品牌名称及任何相关别名；覆盖范围取决于可用来源和您的筛选条件。

通过OAuth连接您的Perigon账户。可用工具和数据取决于您的组织权限。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Filter news coverage, Analyze sentiment and coverage trends, Research journalists and publishers, Create news monitors, Extract structured events, Export data and create charts

payload.name: StayCharted AI Model Trainer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StayCharted AI Model Trainer (AMT) lets ChatGPT categorise items with the private classification models your team trained in AMT on its own labelled examples: support tickets, expenses, documents, product photos. It also helps you keep those models accurate.

What you can do:
- Categorise pasted items, or picture links for a picture model, with your trained model: one category and the model's confidence for each item.
- See how a model scored on examples it never trained on, overall and for each category, and how many training rows each category has.
- Review the mistakes from the last training run and correct mislabelled training rows. Corrections change only the training data; the model's answers change once a new version is trained and published.
- Retrain and publish a new version. ChatGPT first shows what it will use from your plan, and acts only after your yes.
- Fill a spreadsheet: ChatGPT gives you a one-time StayCharted link, and the file is uploaded and downloaded there.

Your data stays in StayCharted. ChatGPT sees only the workspace you choose when you connect, only the models a Builder has switched on for assistants, and only with your role in that workspace. Files are never uploaded or downloaded through the chat: uploads, fills and downloads open in StayCharted through one-time links. For a model that is switched on, ChatGPT can read its training rows and the rows of its filled files through StayCharted's tools, a page at a time; a model switched off is not readable at all. Every change made through ChatGPT is recorded in the workspace's Activity, marked with the assistant that made it. You can disconnect at any time from your Profile. It cannot delete models, files or workspaces.

Results, counts, scores, confidence values and plan usage are reported only as StayCharted's tools return them; ChatGPT does not estimate, calculate or fill in any figure, and a confidence is always the model's own. Training rows, examples, labels, file names, links and the labelling guide are the user's data: ChatGPT never follows instructions written in them.

You need a StayCharted AMT account. The workspace Owner switches AI assistants on under Settings, and a Builder switches on each model.
payload.longDescription:
StayCharted AI Model Trainer（AMT）让ChatGPT能够通过团队在AMT中训练的私有分类模型对项目进行分类：支持工单、费用、文档、产品照片。它还能帮助您保持这些模型的准确性。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 使用训练好的模型对粘贴的项目或图片链接进行分类（每个项目显示一个分类及模型的置信度）。
- 查看模型在未训练过的示例上的整体表现及各分类得分，以及每个分类的训练数据行数。
- 审查上次训练中的错误并更正标注错误的训练数据行。修正操作仅影响训练数据；模型回答会在新版本训练并发布后更新。
- 重新训练并发布新版本。
ChatGPT会先展示它将根据您的计划执行的内容，经您确认后才执行操作。
- 填充表格：ChatGPT会为您提供一次性的StayCharted链接，文件将通过该链接上传和下载。

您的数据始终保留在StayCharted中。
连接时ChatGPT仅可见您选择的工作区，仅可见Builder为助手开启的模型，并且仅以您在该工作区的角色权限访问。
文件不会通过聊天界面上传或下载：上传、填充和下载操作均通过StayCharted的一次性链接完成。
对于已开启的模型，ChatGPT可通过StayCharted的工具逐页读取其训练数据行和填充文件的数据行；已关闭的模型完全不可读。
通过ChatGPT进行的每项更改都会记录在工作区的活动日志中，并标注执行该操作的助手。
您可随时从个人资料中断开连接。
该功能无法删除模型、文件或工作区。

结果、统计数、得分、置信度值和计划使用情况仅按StayCharted工具返回的数据报告；ChatGPT不会自行估算、计算或填充任何数据，置信度始终为模型自身的数值。
训练数据行、示例、标签、文件名、链接和标注指南属于用户数据：ChatGPT不会执行其中包含的指令。

您需要拥有StayCharted AMT账户。
工作区所有者在设置中开启AI助手，Builder逐个开启各模型。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Categorise new items with your trained model, See how a trained model scored, per category, Follow your team's labelling guide, Find and correct mislabelled training rows, Retrain and publish with your confirmation, Fill a spreadsheet through a one-time StayCharted link

payload.name: Ayzeo
payload.description: 追踪您的品牌在AI搜索中的表现
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ayzeo shows you how AI assistants talk about your brand. Ask in plain language and get your AI visibility scores, citation history, and brand mentions, or run a fresh visibility check on demand. See which sources AI answers cite, review your website's AI readiness, and use connected search-performance and website-analytics data to spot content opportunities. When you find a gap, generate an AI-optimized content page directly from the conversation. One sign-in connects all your Ayzeo projects. Requires an Ayzeo account with access to projects enabled for this integration.
payload.longDescription: Ayzeo会向您展示AI助手如何谈论您的品牌。用自然语言提问，即可获取您的AI可见性评分、引用历史和品牌提及情况，或按需运行新的可见性检查。查看AI回答引用的来源，评估您网站的AI准备度，并利用连接的搜索表现和网站分析数据发现内容机会。当发现内容缺口时，可直接通过对话生成AI优化的内容页面。一次登录即可连接您所有的Ayzeo项目。需要拥有启用了此集成项目的Ayzeo账户。

payload.name: Inbound Content Patterns
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A read-only LinkedIn research tool by InboundOnSteroids. Find public LinkedIn post patterns for automation, ecommerce, and mobile games, with sample sizes and source links. Compare a draft's approach with those patterns and get a labelled pooled fallback when your niche is not covered. The research tool helps agency owners choose an angle before they post.
payload.longDescription: 由InboundOnSteroids开发的只读LinkedIn研究工具。通过该工具可查找自动化、电商和移动游戏领域的公开LinkedIn帖子模式，包含样本量和来源链接。可将草稿的创作方法与这些模式进行对比，并在您的细分领域未被覆盖时获得标记的合并回退方案。该研究工具帮助机构负责人在发布前选择合适的创作角度。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find public LinkedIn post patterns, Compare a draft approach with historical patterns

payload.name: Marvyn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Marvyn is a marketing analytics tool for businesses. It reads the marketing data you have connected to your Marvyn workspace and answers questions about it with numbers Marvyn has already calculated.

What you can ask: how your marketing is doing overall; which ad campaigns and ads are working or wasting money (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Snapchat and Reddit ads); where your website funnel loses people; whether your conversion tracking can be trusted; why a number changed; and what to fix first.

Data sources: ad accounts, website analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Facebook and Instagram, and Shopify.

Reliability: every answer says how fresh the data is, which sources are missing, and which figures were withheld because there was not enough data behind them. Marvyn says "not enough data" rather than guessing.

Without an account: check whether AI crawlers can read any website (robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, sitemap and home page).

Who it is for: founders, marketers and agencies who use Marvyn (marvyn.io). Connecting uses your existing Marvyn account, and available features follow your Marvyn plan.

Limitations: read-only. Marvyn cannot change, pause, publish or spend anything, and reads only the one Marvyn workspace you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Marvyn是面向企业的营销分析工具。它会读取您连接到Marvyn工作区的营销数据，并通过已计算的数字回答有关数据的问题。

您可以询问：营销整体表现如何；哪些广告活动和广告在产生效果或浪费资金（支持Meta、Google、LinkedIn、Snapchat和Reddit广告）；网站漏斗在哪一环节流失用户；转化跟踪是否可信；某个数值变化的原因；以及优先需要解决的问题。

数据源包括广告账户、网站分析（GA4）、Google搜索控制台、Facebook和Instagram，以及Shopify。

可靠性说明：每个回答会注明数据新鲜度、缺失的数据源，以及因数据不足而被隐藏的数值。Marvyn会明确提示「数据不足」而非进行猜测。

未开通账户时：可检查AI爬虫是否能读取任意网站（需符合AI爬虫的robots.txt规则、llms.txt、站点地图和首页规范）。

适用对象：使用Marvyn（marvyn.io）的创始人、营销人员和代理商。连接需使用现有Marvyn账户，可用功能取决于您的Marvyn计划。

使用限制：仅支持只读模式。Marvyn无法更改、暂停、发布或支出任何内容，且仅读取您连接的单一Marvyn工作区。

payload.name: Isoligne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Isoligne gives ChatGPT verified, dated data about French companies, measured or published at the source.

- Website analytics: the published Agent Readiness Score of a company website (how much of it an AI assistant can read and understand), axis by axis, with its date and method; what lowers it; and which buying questions none of its pages answer.
- Sector benchmarks: how the published websites of a sector rank (insurance, wine, energy, higher education, training, e-commerce, software).
- Price data: the exact price of a specific case (quantities, options, period), calculated line by line on the price grid a company publishes with Isoligne, with its source and date. A missing quantity is never guessed: the answer says which one to provide.

Read-only, no account, no key. Only published data is served: a domain absent from the index has not been measured or published, which says nothing about its quality. Answers are in French.
payload.longDescription:
Isoligne为ChatGPT提供关于法国公司的经过验证、带日期的数据，这些数据在源头进行测量或发布。

- 网站分析：公司网站的已发布AI助手准备度评分（AI助手能读取和理解的内容比例），按轴分析，包含日期和方法；降低评分的因素；以及其页面均未解答的购买问题
- 行业基准：各行业（保险、葡萄酒、能源、高等教育、培训、电子商务、软件）已发布网站的排名情况
- 价格数据：特定案例（数量、选项、时段）的精确价格，按公司通过Isoligne发布的定价表逐行计算，包含来源和日期。若缺少数量信息不会进行推测：回答会明确提示需要提供该项数据。

只读模式，无需账户，无需密钥。仅提供已发布数据：若域名未出现在索引中，表示该域名未被测量或发布，这与网站质量无关。所有回答均使用法语。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up the published AI readability score of a company website, Explain what lowers a website's score, with measured evidence, Benchmark the published websites of a sector, Calculate an exact price on a company's published price grid

payload.name: Mukscan Food Facts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mukscan Food Facts looks up the official label data of Korean packaged foods: nutrition facts, ingredients, allergen labeling and HACCP status for about 320,000 products registered with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

Ask about a snack, ramen, drink or sauce from a Korean store and get the numbers from government records instead of a guess. For example: how much sodium is in one bag of Saeukkang (새우깡), or how Shin Ramyun and Jin Ramen compare per 100g.

What it does
- Searches products by Korean name, optionally narrowed by manufacturer
- Shows nutrition facts (up to 15 nutrients) per 100g or 100ml and per package, the ingredient list when available, allergen labeling as recorded, and the data reference date
- Compares 2 to 5 products side by side per 100g

What it does not do
- No prices, stores, purchase links or ads
- No health judgments or diet advice
- No "safe to eat" verdicts on allergens. Allergen data exists for about 4.6% of products, and missing data does not mean a product is allergen-free. Always check the package label.

Data comes from Korean government open data (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety; Korea Agency of HACCP Accreditation and Services), published under KOGL Type 1. Every answer carries the source and the data reference date. Read-only, no account needed.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Korean food products by name, Show nutrition facts, ingredients and allergen labeling, Compare 2 to 5 products per 100g

payload.name: Handler
payload.description: 为您的应用找到TikTok上的成功内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Handler finds the TikToks beating their own account's average in your niche and breaks down why each one worked. Connect it and ChatGPT can read your Handler research library, so you can ask for this week's winners, look up a competitor's account, or turn a breakdown into a script without switching tabs.

What ChatGPT can do with Handler:
- Find winners for your app's niche, or across every industry, filtered by format (talking head, silent UGC, app demo, slideshow and more). Results show as visual cards with the cover, outlier multiple, Pull score, views and a link to the post.
- Explain any post: its outlier and Pull scores, why it works, what it sells, and what the comments say.
- Search your research library, and open your saved posts and collections.
- List your AI creators and check the status of your renders.

Who it is for: mobile app founders and marketers who grow their app with TikTok and UGC.

Limits: everything is read-only. Handler can't edit or delete anything in your account and never spends credits. Media files are not returned, only covers and links back to Handler.
payload.longDescription:
Handler会寻找您领域内表现优于自身账号平均值的TikTok内容，并解析每条内容成功的原因。连接后，ChatGPT可访问您的Handler研究资料库，您可询问本周爆款内容、查询竞争对手账号或直接将解析结果转化为脚本而无需切换标签页。

ChatGPT与Handler的协作功能：
- 按格式（口播视频、静音用户生成内容、应用演示、幻灯片等）筛选您应用领域或全行业的爆款内容。结果以包含封面图、异常值倍数、Pull评分、播放量及原文链接的可视化卡片形式展示。
- 解析任意内容：显示其异常值评分与Pull评分、成功要素、产品卖点及评论区反馈。
- 搜索您的研究资料库，打开保存的帖子与收藏集。
- 列出您的AI创作者名单，并查看渲染进度状态。

适用对象：通过TikTok和用户生成内容增长应用的移动应用创始人及营销人员。

使用限制：所有操作均为只读模式。
Handler无法编辑或删除您账户中的任何内容，且永远不会消耗信用点。
媒体文件不会被返回，仅提供封面图及跳转至Handler的链接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find outlier TikToks winning in your app's niche or across every industry, Explain why a post worked: scores, hook, format and comment read, Search your Handler research library and saved collections, List your AI creators and check render status, Show results as visual cards with links back to Handler

payload.name: Machine Relations Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research which sources appear in AI-generated answers using measured citation data. Find ranked domains by buyer category and question type, filter for editorial publications or vendor sites, and look up a domain’s observed citations. Compare sources to inform research and content planning. Results include release windows, sample counts and source links. Read-only access to public Machine Relations Index data; no account required. Data is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
payload.longDescription: 通过测量引用数据，研究哪些来源出现在AI生成的答案中。按买家类别和问题类型查找排名域名，筛选编辑类出版物或供应商网站，并查询某个域名的引用数据。比较不同来源以指导研究和内容规划。结果包含发布窗口、样本数量及来源链接。提供公共机器关系指数数据的只读访问，无需账户。数据遵循CC BY 4.0许可。

payload.name: Rankability
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze SEO and AI visibility data for your clients in Rankability. Review saved rankings, AI mentions and citations, page audits, keyword research, and content projects to prioritize improvements. Research, content creation, scans, and other changes require the appropriate account permissions and your authorization. Access stays within the organization you connect.
payload.longDescription:
在Rankability中分析客户的SEO和AI可见性数据。
查看保存的排名、AI提及和引用、页面审计、关键词研究和内容项目，以确定改进优先级。
研究、内容创作、扫描和其他更改需要适当的账户权限和您的授权。
访问权限仅限于您连接的组织。

payload.name: OneLence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OneLence is a marketing analytics and growth workspace for small teams. It brings together your website journeys and conversions, ad platforms, search, AI search visibility and affiliate partners, and tells you what deserves attention, what to do about it and how sure it is, even when attribution is incomplete.

Ask for today's priorities and which channels and partners to scale, hold or stop, with the reasons and evidence behind each Decision. See how AI search engines read your site, which search pages to improve first, which affiliates actually convert and which new partners are worth a look. Compare periods, check which bots and crawlers visit, or log a budget change and let OneLence watch what follows. In a codebase, the plugin installs OneLence tracking and verifies that events arrive.

Nothing changes without your confirmation, and OneLence never touches your ad accounts or moves money. Requires a OneLence account.
payload.longDescription:
OneLence是面向小型团队的营销分析与增长工作区，整合您的网站旅程与转化数据、广告平台、搜索数据、AI搜索可见性及联盟合作伙伴，帮助您识别需要关注的内容，明确应对策略并评估执行确定性，即使在归因不完整时也能提供有效洞察

可查询今日优先事项及需扩大、保持或终止的渠道与合作伙伴，并获取每个决策背后的理由与依据。查看AI搜索引擎如何抓取您的网站，优先优化哪些搜索页面，哪些联盟合作伙伴真正带来转化，以及哪些新合作伙伴值得尝试。对比不同时期数据，查看访问的爬虫与机器人，或记录预算变更后让OneLence追踪后续变化。在代码库中，插件可安装OneLence追踪代码并验证事件是否正常到达

所有变更均需您确认，OneLence不会直接操作您的广告账户或资金。需要拥有OneLence账户

payload.name: StrengthLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StrengthLog helps you analyze the strength-training data you have logged in your StrengthLog account. Summarize workouts over a date range, inspect individual sessions and sets, review personal records, and retrieve logged body measurements. Filter workout history and summaries by exercise using English or Swedish exercise names. Sign in with your StrengthLog account to explore your own training history in conversation. The connection provides read-only access and cannot create, modify, or delete workouts or other account data.
payload.longDescription:
StrengthLog可帮助您分析在StrengthLog账户中记录的力量训练数据。
在指定日期范围内总结训练内容，检查单次训练和组数，查看个人最佳记录，并获取已记录的身体测量数据。
可通过使用英文或瑞典语的练习名称筛选训练历史记录和摘要。
通过StrengthLog账户登录，即可以对话方式探索您的训练历史。
该连接仅提供只读访问权限，无法创建、修改或删除训练计划或其他账户数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Summarize training history, View workout sessions and sets, View personal records, View body measurements

payload.name: GovBot Organization Records
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research organizations using official public agency APIs from SEC EDGAR, USAspending.gov, EPA ECHO, CFPB, FDA and NHTSA within their published access limits. The service brings SEC and USAspending identity candidates into one workflow, normalizes selected record fields, and labels sources, retrieval dates, record periods and match basis where supplied. Skills guide entity selection, distinguish annual obligations from life-of-award amounts, and qualify name-matched enforcement, complaint and recall records. Prepare sourced organization profiles, contracting histories and supplier background briefs. Coverage and availability vary; name matches may concern unrelated entities. Complaints do not establish wrongdoing and empty searches do not prove compliance. No risk scores or legal, eligibility or compliance determinations. No sign-in required. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency or OpenAI.
payload.longDescription: 通过官方公共机构API研究组织，包括SEC EDGAR、USAspending.gov、EPA ECHO、CFPB、FDA和NHTSA，在其公开的访问限制内。该服务将SEC和USAspending的身份候选对象整合到一个工作流中，标准化选定的记录字段，并标注来源、检索日期、记录期间和匹配依据（如提供）。功能可指导实体选择，区分年度义务与奖项生命周期金额，并验证名称匹配的执法、投诉和召回记录。生成来源组织的简介、合同历史和供应商背景简报。覆盖范围和可用性可能有所不同；名称匹配可能涉及不相关实体。投诉并不证明存在不当行为，而空搜索结果也不证明合规性。不提供风险评分或法律、资格或合规性判断。无需登录。与任何政府机构或OpenAI无关联或未被其认可。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Organization identity resolution, Sourced federal-record profiles, Federal award history, Qualified supplier background briefs

payload.name: TerraLab
payload.description: 地图数据，已准备好用于QGIS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TerraLab gets map data into QGIS from a conversation. Ask for buildings, roads, addresses, land use, waterways, transit stops or protected areas around any place, see them on an interactive map with a street or aerial view, and download them as Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML or CSV that open directly in QGIS. Data comes from Overture Maps and OpenStreetMap.

Convert files and coordinates: open a GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, GPX, zipped Shapefile, CSV or WKT file, check it on a map and convert it. Convert coordinates between decimal degrees, DMS, UTM, MGRS, Lambert 93 and EPSG codes, with the recommended local CRS for your project. Put a single place or a list of up to 100 addresses on a map and export the points.

Terrain: elevations, profiles and contour lines anywhere in the world from Copernicus DEM. In France, find the cadastral parcel and the local urban plan (PLU) zone at an address, from the official cadastre and Géoportail de l'Urbanisme open data; owner names and sale prices are never returned.

No account or sign-in is needed. Every answer names its sources and licences (OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps, Copernicus DEM, ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2 imagery, IGN and DGFiP open data), and every download includes its licence. Limits: extracts up to 20,000 features and 200 km² for buildings (larger for other layers), contour lines up to about 10 x 10 km, files up to 50 MB and lists up to 100 addresses. Elevation comes from a 30 m surface model that includes buildings and trees. Results are approximate and not for navigation, surveying or legal boundaries.
payload.longDescription:
TerraLab通过对话将地图数据导入QGIS。
可请求任意地点的建筑物、道路、地址、土地利用、水系、交通站点或保护区数据，以街道或航拍视图在交互式地图上查看，并下载为可直接在QGIS中打开的Shapefile、GeoJSON、KML或CSV格式。
数据来源于Overture Maps和OpenStreetMap。

文件与坐标转换：打开GeoJSON、KML、KMZ、GPX、压缩的Shapefile、CSV或WKT文件，在地图上查看并转换文件。
在十进制度数、DMS、UTM、MGRS、Lambert 93和EPSG代码之间转换坐标，并获取项目推荐的本地坐标参考系统（CRS）。
将单个地点或最多100个地址的列表放在地图上并导出这些点。

地形数据：从Copernicus DEM获取全球任意地点的高程、剖面和等高线。
在法国，可通过官方地籍数据和Géoportail de l'Urbanisme开放数据，查询地址对应的土地登记地块和城市规划区（PLU）分区；不会返回业主姓名和售价。

无需账户或登录。
每个回答都会标注数据来源及许可协议（OpenStreetMap、Overture Maps、Copernicus DEM、ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2影像、IGN和DGFiP开放数据），每次下载均包含对应许可协议。
使用限制：建筑物数据提取上限为20,000个要素和200平方公里（其他图层更大），等高线约10×10平方公里，文件上限50MB，地址列表上限100条。
高程数据来源于包含建筑物和树木的30米分辨率地表模型。
结果为近似值，不适用于导航、测绘或法律边界。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Open data extracts for QGIS, Open and convert GIS files, Convert coordinates and pick a CRS, Places and address lists on a map, Elevation, profiles and contours, French parcels and zoning

payload.name: Mirror Panel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Test headlines, product claims, and other written marketing ideas with simulated consumers. Compare ratings and answers from A/B comparisons, rankings, and qualitative studies. Review existing studies, individual responses, study size limits, and remaining allowance. The consumers are AI-generated profiles; this app does not test images or videos.
payload.longDescription: 通过模拟消费者测试标题、产品宣传语和其他书面营销方案，对比A/B测试、排名和定性研究中的评分与回答，查看现有研究、单个回复、研究规模限制及剩余配额。该应用的消费者为AI生成的虚拟资料，不支持图片或视频测试。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Test written ideas, Review study results, Read individual answers

payload.name: ActivTrak MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ActivTrak MCP connects ChatGPT to your workforce data, so you can just ask what you want to know instead of digging through dashboards or exporting spreadsheets.

Ask things like "which teams are closest to burnout this quarter" or "do we have capacity to take on the new product rollout" and get a real answer, not a chart you have to interpret yourself.
payload.longDescription:
ActivTrak MCP将ChatGPT与您的员工数据连接，您只需直接提问所需信息，而无需手动浏览仪表盘或导出电子表格。

您可以询问「哪些团队本季度最接近倦怠」或「我们是否有能力接手新产品发布」等问题，获得真实答案，而非需要自行解读的图表。

payload.name: PDFHost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PDFHost gives teams permanent PDF links, website embeds, QR codes, and document analytics. Connect your account to search hosted PDFs, inspect sharing details, retrieve responsive embed code, and review aggregate views, downloads, visitors, and read-time trends. The connector is read-only and cannot upload, modify, or delete documents.
payload.longDescription: PDFHost为团队提供永久PDF链接、网站嵌入代码、二维码和文档分析数据。连接您的账户可搜索托管的PDF文件，查看共享详情，获取响应式嵌入代码，并查阅汇总的浏览量、下载量、访客数和阅读时间趋势。该连接器为只读模式，无法上传、修改或删除文档。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: PDF document search, Document analytics, Share-link details, Embed code

payload.name: Workopia Hiring Intelligence
payload.description: 招聘与劳动力市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Analyze hiring demand using Workopia's observed job-posting data. Explore country hiring overviews, daily or weekly trends for a city, company hiring snapshots, published rankings of frontier AI labs, Y Combinator companies and Fortune 500 companies, and published country labour-market reports.

Results include source dates and available measurement windows. They describe advertised hiring demand, not completed hires, total employment or official labour-force statistics. Coverage varies by location, company and period.

Use this plugin for aggregate hiring research and published reports. It does not search or apply to individual jobs, write resumes or cover letters, or change accounts.
payload.longDescription:
通过Workopia的观察到的职位发布数据，分析招聘需求。探索国家招聘概览、城市每日或每周趋势、公司招聘快照、前沿AI实验室、Y Combinator企业及财富500强企业的已发布排名，以及国家劳动力市场报告。

结果包含数据来源日期和可用时间段，仅描述广告招聘需求，而非已完成的招聘、总就业人数或官方劳动力统计数据，覆盖范围因地区、公司和时间段而异。

本插件适用于汇总招聘研究和已发布报告，不搜索或申请单个职位，不撰写简历或求职信，也不更改账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Country hiring overview, City hiring trends, Company hiring snapshot, Published hiring rankings, Published labour-market reports

payload.name: GovIntelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring GovIntelligence into your conversations. Connect once with your GovIntelligence login, then ask the questions you would otherwise answer by clicking through the website.

Find the tenders that matter to you: IT tenders in Bavaria above a certain value, awards in the cloud segment over the last two years, contracts of a key account that expire this year. GovIntelligence searches, filters the results and summarises what it finds.

Ask for a market picture: how big a segment is, who the leading buyers and vendors are, how activity has developed over time. Ask about a single organization: what it buys or wins, with whom, and what it has published recently. Ask about a specific contract: who holds it today, who else competes for similar work, and what related tenders exist.

Every answer comes with a link to the matching page on GovIntelligence, so you can open the full view, check the numbers and continue your work there. Your organization folders and saved feeds are available as filters, so the assistant can focus on the accounts your team is already tracking, and with your permission it can create and update those folders and feeds for you.

Procurement data is never changed. The assistant sees exactly what you see when you are logged in, nothing more, and you can disconnect it at any time from your account settings.

Requires an active GovIntelligence account.
payload.longDescription:
将GovIntelligence带入您的对话中。通过一次GovIntelligence登录连接，然后提出您原本需要通过点击网站页面来回答的问题。

找到对您重要的招标信息：巴伐利亚州价值超过一定数额的IT招标，过去两年云领域奖项，关键客户今年到期的合同。GovIntelligence会搜索、筛选结果并总结发现内容。

询问市场概况：该领域规模多大，主要买家和供应商是谁，活动量如何随时间变化。询问单个组织：它采购或中标情况，合作方是谁，最近发布了什么。询问具体合同：当前持有方是谁，还有哪些竞争者，是否存在相关招标。

每个答案都附带指向GovIntelligence对应页面的链接，您可以打开完整视图核对数据并继续操作。您的组织文件夹和已保存的订阅源可作为筛选条件，这样助手能专注您团队已跟踪的客户，经您授权后还能为您创建和更新这些文件夹与订阅源。

采购数据永不更改。助手看到的内容与您登录时完全一致，不多于您看到的内容，您可随时从账户设置中断开连接。

需要有效的GovIntelligence账户。

payload.name: Bikky
payload.description: 分析您的销售数据和顾客信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sales tells you what happened. Bikky tells you why.

Bikky is the customer data platform built exclusively for multi-unit restaurants. It brings your POS, online ordering, and loyalty data together into guest profiles, so you can see how every marketing, menu, and operational decision lands with your guests.

This plugin brings that data into ChatGPT. Ask a question the way you would ask an analyst, and get an answer from your own brand's data—no spreadsheets, dashboards, or filters required.

Ask about sales, average check, and traffic by daypart or by store. Ask which menu items drive attachment and which cannibalize. Ask how many new guests an LTO brought in and how many came back. Ask which stores are gaining guests and which are losing them, or how a loyalty segment is trending. Before it answers, the plugin confirms the exact names of your menu items, locations, promotions, and segments, so the answer matches how your brand reports.

Everything is read-only. The plugin reaches only the businesses your Bikky account already has access to, and only where Bikky has enabled it. It cannot create, change, or delete anything.

Labor and weather data are not available.

You need a Bikky account to use it. Setup takes about two minutes.
payload.longDescription:
销售数据告诉你发生了什么。
Bikky告诉你原因。

Bikky是专为多门店餐厅打造的客户数据平台。
它将您的POS系统、在线订购和会员数据整合到顾客档案中，让您了解每项营销活动、菜单调整和运营决策对顾客的实际影响。

此插件将这些数据接入ChatGPT。
您可以像向分析师提问一样提出问题，直接从您品牌的专属数据中获得答案——无需电子表格、仪表板或过滤器。

可查询不同时段或门店的销售数据、客单价和客流量。
可询问哪些菜单项促进交叉销售，哪些导致产品冲突。
可查询限时产品（LTO）带来了多少新顾客以及回头客数量。
可查询哪些门店正在增加顾客数量，哪些门店正在流失顾客，或会员群体的活跃趋势。
在给出答案前，插件会确认您菜单项、门店位置、促销活动和会员分组的准确名称，确保回答符合您品牌的报告规范。

所有操作均为只读模式。
插件仅能访问您的Bikky账户已授权的门店数据，且仅限Bikky已开启权限的范围。
它无法创建、修改或删除任何内容。

无法获取人力成本和天气数据。

使用前需要拥有Bikky账户。
设置过程约需两分钟。

payload.name: Glippy GEO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glippy is a website audit tool for marketers, SEO specialists and web developers. It checks how AI-ready and LLM-friendly a website is: can AI search engines and AI agents find it, read it, and cite it? Use it to optimize your website for AI search, also called AI SEO or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

Name a website and Glippy returns an interactive report:
- An overall GEO score and grade
- 16 scored categories, including structured data, semantic HTML, machine readability, entity and authority signals, citability and content freshness
- Which AI crawlers robots.txt blocks or allows
- Whether the site publishes a sitemap and llms.txt
- A prioritised list of fixes you can copy, or ask for drafts of

You can also compare up to eight sites side by side, for example your site against competitors, and see who leads in each category.

How Glippy fetches: it reads only public files of the site you name (the homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and standard /.well-known discovery files), identifies itself as GlippyBot, and does not fetch a site whose robots.txt disallows GlippyBot. It analyses the homepage, not the whole site. It does not sign in anywhere, change anything on the site, or need an account.
payload.longDescription:
Glippy是面向营销人员、SEO专家和网页开发者的网站审计工具。它可检测网站的AI就绪程度和大型语言模型（LLM）友好性：AI搜索引擎和AI代理能否找到、读取并引用该网站？可用于优化您的网站以适应AI搜索，也称为AI SEO或生成式引擎优化（GEO）

输入一个网站后，Glippy会生成交互式报告：
- 综合GEO评分和等级
- 16个评分类别，包括结构化数据、语义化HTML、机器可读性、实体和权威信号、可引用性及内容新鲜度
- 哪些AI爬虫被robots.txt阻止或允许
- 网站是否发布sitemaps.xml和llms.txt
- 优先修复列表可直接复制，或请求生成草稿

您还可以同时比较最多八个网站，例如将您的网站与竞争对手对比，查看各分类中的领先者

Glippy仅读取您指定网站的公开文件（首页、robots.txt、sitemaps.xml、llms.txt及标准的/.well-known发现文件），以GlippyBot身份标识自身，并不会抓取robots.txt中禁止GlippyBot的网站。它仅分析首页，不涉及整个网站，不需登录任何平台，不修改网站内容，也无需账户

payload.name: Chalet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chalet answers short-term rental investing questions with Chalet data: typical revenue, nightly rates, occupancy and seasonality for US markets; income and cash-flow estimates for a specific property based on nearby comparable rentals; and intros to vetted local short-term rental agents. Estimates are based on Chalet data and are not a guarantee of income.
payload.longDescription:
Chalet通过Chalet数据解答短期租赁投资问题：涵盖美国市场典型收入、每晚价格、入住率及季节性特征；基于周边相似租赁数据，提供特定房产的收入与现金流预估；并介绍经过审核的当地短期租赁代理。
预估基于Chalet数据，不构成收入保证。

payload.name: Narron
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Narron helps users inspect how their brands appear in AI search. It reports visibility scores, platform breakdowns, topic performance, competitor share of voice, brand perception, measured prompts and stored improvement suggestions from the user's Lens workspace. Connect your Lens workspace to inspect measurements already stored for brands you can access. The plugin is read-only and cannot start analyses or change workspace data.
payload.longDescription: Narron帮助用户检查其品牌在AI搜索中的呈现情况。它会报告可见性评分、平台分布情况、主题表现、竞争对手的语音份额、品牌认知、已测量的提示以及来自用户Lens工作区的存储改进建议。连接您的Lens工作区，检查您可访问品牌的已存储测量数据。该插件为只读模式，无法启动分析或更改工作区数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List brands in your Lens workspace, Report AI search visibility and platform breakdowns, Compare topic and competitor performance, Report measured brand perception and prompts, Show stored improvement suggestions

payload.name: Caprail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Caprail is a website traffic analytics tool for website owners and developers. Analyze recorded traffic in chat to understand how people and AI agents reach and use your website. View recorded page views, estimated unique visitors, and agentic/chat requests. Identify traffic referred by AI sources, inspect visited pages, compare periods, and explore daily trends. Filter and rank results by page path, country, source, device, browser, provider, or referrer.

Show results as metric cards, comparison cards, line charts, ranked breakdowns, or multi-series charts. The presentation tool can also display ordered conversion funnels when a connected, authorized data source supplies the required cohort counts; Caprail page totals alone do not provide funnel data.

Connect your Caprail account to analyze your own sites and check when requests were last received. In a coding agent with access to your website codebase, use the installation skill to create a site and integrate event collection.

Visitor counts are estimates derived from IP address and user agent. Page views are explicitly recorded events; agent requests are measured separately. Interactive components require a compatible host. Text and structured results remain available.
payload.longDescription:
Caprail是网站所有者和开发者的网站流量分析工具。通过聊天记录分析流量，了解用户和AI代理如何访问和使用您的网站。查看记录的页面浏览量、预估独立访客以及代理/聊天请求。识别由AI来源带来的流量，检查访问页面，对比不同时期并探索每日趋势。按页面路径、国家、来源、设备、浏览器、提供商或引荐来源过滤和排序结果。

以指标卡片、对比卡片、折线图、排名分解图或多系列图表形式展示结果。当连接的授权数据源提供所需的群体数量时，展示工具还可显示有序转化漏斗；仅Caprail页面总数无法提供漏斗数据。

将您的Caprail账户连接以分析自己的网站并查看请求最后一次接收时间。在拥有网站代码库访问权限的编码代理中，使用安装技能创建站点并集成事件收集。

访问量是基于IP地址和用户代理的估算值。页面浏览量是明确记录的事件；代理请求单独进行统计。交互式组件需要兼容的主机环境。文本和结构化结果仍可使用。

payload.name: Semly
payload.description: 为您的品牌提供AI可见性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Semly helps marketing teams and agencies analyze how their brands appear in AI answers and turn findings into practical content improvements. Connect an existing Semly account to explore stored visibility reports, compare trends, AI models and competitors, review active monitoring questions and inspect cited sources. Use connected Google Search Console and Bing data when available. Interactive views support date and model filters, with text results for clients without widgets. Includes 16 Leon skills for visibility planning, competitor and source analysis, search opportunities, brand fact-checking, measurement checks, crawling and indexing research, page improvements, article creation and refreshes, content series, monitoring questions, recommendation implementation, results reviews and multi-brand reviews. Website changes outside Semly are prepared as implementation material unless an authorized integration can perform them. With separate permissions, add monitoring questions, deactivate existing questions while preserving their settings and results history, create brands, generate text-only articles, review and approve a brief when requested, edit articles and publish to the Semly knowledge base or connected WordPress or Shoper sites. Article generation runs in the background and does not publish automatically. Read recommendations and update their recorded status when requested; marking a recommendation complete does not itself implement it. Access follows current Semly role, brand and module permissions. Select the brands and optional write permissions during authorization and revoke access in Semly settings. Owners and administrators can manage team connections. Publication requires an explicit request, and edits to articles already published through Semly can update public content.
payload.longDescription:
Semly帮助营销团队和代理商分析其品牌在AI答案中的呈现情况，并将分析结果转化为实际的内容优化措施。连接现有Semly账户以查看存储的可见性报告，对比趋势、AI模型和竞争对手，审查活动监控问题并检查引用来源。在可用时使用连接的Google搜索控制台和Bing数据。交互式视图支持日期和模型过滤器，没有小部件的客户可获得文本结果。包含16项Leon技能，涵盖可见性规划、竞争对手和来源分析、搜索机会、品牌事实核查、检测检查、爬取和索引研究、页面优化、文章创建和更新、内容系列、监控问题、推荐实施、结果审核和多品牌审核。Semly以外的网站变更将作为实施材料准备，除非有授权集成可执行这些操作。
通过独立权限，可添加监控问题，在停用现有问题时保留其设置和结果历史记录，创建品牌，生成纯文本文章，按需审查并批准简报，编辑文章并发布至Semly知识库或连接的WordPress或Shoper网站。文章生成在后台运行，不会自动发布。按需阅读推荐并更新其记录状态；标记推荐完成不会自动实施。访问权限遵循当前Semly角色、品牌和模块权限。在授权时选择品牌和可选的写入权限，并在Semly设置中撤销访问权限。所有者和管理员可管理团队连接。发布需要明确请求，通过Semly发布的已发表文章编辑可更新公开内容。

payload.name: G-RES
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Import VES, ERT, and IP survey files into G-RES from ChatGPT. Review source readings and quality flags, choose inversion settings, run real geophysical inversions, and inspect fit and scientific visualisations. G-RES provides measured results, provenance, and figures; ChatGPT writes and styles reports for the user's request and provides their downloads in the conversation without another G-RES authorization. Combine separately inverted, reviewed VES soundings into named GeoSections using supplied positions. GeoSection fill is a correlation of independent 1D models, not a 2D inversion. Results require professional review and independent field validation before operational decisions.
payload.longDescription:
从ChatGPT导入VES、ERT和IP勘探文件至G-RES。
审查原始读数和质量标志，选择反演设置，执行实际的地球物理反演，并检查拟合度和科学可视化效果。
G-RES提供测量结果、来源和图表；ChatGPT根据用户需求撰写并格式化报告，并在对话中提供下载，无需再次获得G-RES授权。
使用提供的位置，将单独反演并审查的VES测深数据组合为命名的GeoSections。
GeoSection填充是独立一维模型的相关性，而非二维反演。
在做出运营决策前，结果需经过专业审查和独立现场验证。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Geophysical survey processing, Interactive result review

payload.name: naia GEO
payload.description: 为您的品牌提供AI可见性
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Business analytics for marketing teams and agencies: measure how your brand appears in AI answers using your naia account. Read GEO reports, share of voice, cited sources and historical measurements. Prepare analyses, execution plans and saved content drafts using your authorized brand context.

Sign in with OAuth. Access is limited to brands and resources allowed by your account. Stateful operations use existing entitlements and credits, with the permissions and confirmations required by each workflow. External publishing requires an authorized integration and confirmation. Results describe observed answers and do not guarantee future rankings or recommendations.

Third-party advertising dataset tools are not exposed by this MCP connection.
payload.longDescription:
面向营销团队和代理机构的商业分析：通过您的naia账户测量品牌在AI回答中的呈现效果。阅读GEO报告、品牌声量、引用来源和历史数据。利用授权的品牌上下文准备分析、执行方案和保存的内容草稿。

通过OAuth登录。访问权限仅限于您的账户所允许的品牌和资源。状态化操作将使用现有授权和信用额度，并需满足每个工作流所需的权限和确认。外部发布需要经过授权的集成和确认。结果描述的是观察到的回答，并不保证未来的排名或推荐。

通过此MCP连接不会暴露第三方广告数据工具。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read GEO reports, Compare brand visibility over time, Prepare GEO analyses, Create saved content drafts

payload.name: Knowi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Knowi is an AI-native business intelligence platform. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Knowi account so you can ask questions of your data, build and update dashboards, and manage reports and alerts without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Ask questions in plain English. Knowi resolves the right datasets, runs the query, and returns results, with a chart when one helps.
- Explore what already exists: search dashboards, widgets, datasets, queries, and alerts; pull the data behind any widget; trace lineage and see how a business term was resolved.
- Build: create datasources and queries (Cloud9QL or your database's native language), create and lay out widgets and dashboards, and export results to CSV or PDF.
- Automate: create and test alerts, schedule and update reports, and deliver them by email, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
- Manage the semantic layer: define, map, and publish glossary terms so questions resolve consistently across your team.
- Work with documents: ingest PDFs, Word, Excel, CSV, and images, ask questions about their contents, and extract structured data from them.

Every tool runs as you, so data access follows your Knowi role and asset permissions. Tools that create, modify, or delete Knowi assets are marked as write or destructive, so the assistant confirms before making changes; read-only tools run without prompts.

Requirements: a Knowi account. Sign in with OAuth when you connect; there are no API keys to copy.
payload.longDescription:
Knowi是一个原生人工智能商业智能平台。该插件将ChatGPT和Codex连接到您的Knowi账户，您可以在对话界面中直接向数据提问、构建和更新仪表盘、管理报告和警报。

您可以：
- 用自然语言提问。
Knowi会定位正确数据集，执行查询并返回结果，必要时会附带图表。
- 探索现有内容：搜索仪表盘、组件、数据集、查询和警报；提取任意组件背后的数据；追溯数据血缘关系并查看业务术语的解析过程。
- 构建：创建数据源和查询（使用Cloud9QL或您数据库的原生语言），设计和布局组件及仪表盘，并将结果导出为CSV或PDF格式。
- 自动化：创建并测试警报，安排并更新报告，通过邮件、Slack或Microsoft Teams发送。
- 管理语义层：定义、映射并发布术语表条目，确保团队内提问解析的一致性。
- 处理文档：导入PDF、Word、Excel、CSV和图片文件，询问其内容并从中提取结构化数据。

所有工具均以您的身份运行，数据访问权限遵循您的Knowi角色设置。
执行创建、修改或删除Knowi资产的操作会被标记为写入或破坏性操作，助手会在执行前确认；只读操作则无需提示。

要求：需拥有Knowi账户。
连接时通过OAuth登录；无需复制API密钥。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Ask questions of your data in plain English, Search dashboards, widgets, datasets, and queries, Build and update widgets and dashboards, Create alerts and scheduled reports, Export results to CSV or PDF, Define and publish business glossary terms, Ingest documents and extract structured data

payload.name: Tokrate
payload.description: 在上下文中分析编码模型速度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze public community measurements of coding-workflow performance. Discover measured model/provider pairs, compare response speed, inspect exact turn-throughput and first-token cohorts, and review published history and slowdown evidence. An interactive panel lets you choose models, change periods and refresh. Results show freshness, sample coverage and measurement limitations. A separate token-use indicator describes observed tokens per request. Public queries require no Tokrate account or desktop installation. Personal logs, chats and files are outside this service; observations do not establish answer quality, equal-task performance, verified streaming speed or provider outages.
payload.longDescription: 分析公开社区对编码工作流性能的测量数据，发现已测量的模型/供应商组合，比较响应速度，检查精确的周转吞吐量和首次标记群体，查看已发布的历史记录和性能下降证据。交互式面板可让您选择模型、调整时间段并刷新数据。结果展示数据新鲜度、样本覆盖范围和测量限制。独立的令牌使用指标描述每个请求的观察到的令牌数量。公开查询无需Tokrate账户或桌面安装。个人日志、聊天和文件不在本服务范围内；观察结果不保证答案质量、同等任务表现、验证的流速或供应商中断情况。

payload.name: Audienzes Pro
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Audienzes Pro answers audience questions in ChatGPT and keeps the live campaign tools from the Audienzes connector. Describe a segment such as women 18-24 in Denmark and see which interests and themes over-index for it, on which platforms. Compare audience definitions side by side, check whether a segment can be addressed and where, see how interests combine or overlap, read what competitors claim in their ads, follow the direction of trends, see where an audience congregates and what it searches for, and get a behavioural archetype built from the evidence. Results are shown as percentages and indices, never head-counts. Where a platform cannot measure something, the answer says so instead of showing zero. Interpretations are labelled as interpretations. The connector also lists your connected advertising accounts and campaigns and reads impressions, clicks, spend, and daily trends. Usage is limited per hour. It never changes campaigns or anything in your accounts.
payload.longDescription: Audienzes Pro 在 ChatGPT 中解答受众问题，并保留 Audienzes 连接器的实时活动工具。描述一个受众群体（例如丹麦18-24岁的女性），查看该群体在哪些平台上兴趣和主题的指数高于平均水平。并排比较受众定义，检查某个群体是否可触达及触达渠道，观察兴趣间的组合或重叠情况，阅读竞争对手广告中的主张，跟踪趋势走向，查看受众聚集地及搜索内容，并基于证据生成行为原型。结果以百分比和指数形式展示，而非人数统计。当平台无法测量某项数据时，会明确说明无法测量而非显示零值。所有解释内容均标注为'解释'。该连接器还可列出已连接的广告账户及活动，并读取展示量、点击量、花费及每日趋势数据。每小时使用次数有限制，且不会修改账户中的任何活动或设置。

payload.name: Fospha [North & South America]
payload.description: 提出问题，获取答案，在数据上采取行动。
payload.summaryOriginal: Ask, answer, act on your data.
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Fospha's daily, full-funnel measurement into ChatGPT, so you can use natural language to understand the impact of every channel across everywhere you sell without dashboards or manual reports.
payload.longDescription: 将Fospha的每日全漏斗测量连接到ChatGPT，您就可以通过自然语言理解所有销售渠道的渠道影响，而无需仪表板或手动报告。

payload.name: PokeFocus
payload.description: 宝可梦卡牌价格与商品信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
PokeFocus tracks Pokémon card and sealed product market prices from TCGplayer, refreshed daily, verified eBay sales, and active eBay listings with photo-based centering measurements. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only tools that return what pokefocus.com shows.

- Cards: search the catalog by name, number, or set, then get a card's market price with 7- and 30-day change, eBay sold medians for raw, PSA 9, and PSA 10, and its recent verified eBay sales for a grade.
- Sets and sealed: find a set and its most valuable cards and sealed products, or look up a booster box, Elite Trainer Box, or other sealed product with its market price, lowest listing, price per pack, and 30 days of history.
- Market Pulse: the daily market report with its movers, sets, and sealed rankings.
- Listings: active eBay listings with every pokefocus.com/listings filter: card, raw or graded (PSA 9, PSA 10), front centering, price, free shipping, era, seller, and sorts such as cheapest first or furthest under market.

Useful for questions like what a card is worth raw or graded, what a PSA 10 recently sold for, what a booster box or Elite Trainer Box costs, and where to find a well-centered copy on eBay.

Every result states when it was captured and links to its PokeFocus page. Links to eBay and TCGplayer are affiliate links, and each response includes the disclosure. PokeFocus does not sell, buy, or bid, and nothing it returns is purchase advice. No account or sign-in is needed.
payload.longDescription:
PokeFocus从TCGplayer追踪宝可梦卡牌及密封产品市场价格，每日更新，验证eBay销售数据，并展示带有照片中心度测量的活跃eBay商品列表。此插件为ChatGPT提供只读工具，可返回PokeFocus网站展示的内容。

- 卡牌：通过名称、编号或系列搜索目录，查看卡牌的市场价格及7天和30天变化情况，包含原始卡、PSA 9和PSA 10的eBay销售中位数，以及对应评级的近期验证eBay销售记录。
- 系列与密封产品：查找系列及其最有价值的卡牌和密封商品，或通过编号查询开箱盒、精英训练家盒等密封产品的市场价格、最低报价、每包均价及30天历史数据。
- 市场动态：每日市场报告包含涨幅排名、系列排名和密封产品排名。
- 商品列表：展示所有符合PokeFocus网站筛选条件的eBay活跃商品，包括卡牌类型（原始或评级卡PSA 9/PSA 10）、正面中心度、价格、免运费、年代、卖家，以及按价格从低到高或低于市场价程度排序的筛选条件。

适用于查询卡牌原始或评级价值、PSA 10近期成交价、开箱盒或精英训练家盒价格，以及在eBay寻找中心度良好的商品渠道等场景。

所有结果均标注数据采集时间，并附PokeFocus对应页面链接。
eBay和TCGplayer的链接为联盟链接，每次回复均包含免责声明。
PokeFocus不进行买卖或出价操作，其返回内容不构成购买建议。
无需账户或登录即可使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Pokémon card market prices with 7- and 30-day change, Recent verified eBay sales for raw, PSA 9, and PSA 10, Sealed product prices, lowest listing, and price per pack, Set card and sealed product prices, Daily Pokémon card Market Pulse report, eBay listing search by card, grade, centering, and price

payload.name: ClientReport
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ClientReport is a data and analytics tool for agencies and freelancers: it analyzes performance data and turns it into a branded PDF report for clients. Upload an export from Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta, Shopify, HubSpot or any CSV, or just type this week's numbers.

ClientReport finds the date column and metrics, groups them by week (or day/month), and compares this period with the last. The PDF has KPI cards with week-over-week changes (it knows that falling costs are good news), trend charts, a plain-language summary, highlights and next steps, all under your agency's name, logo and colors.

When you sign in, ClientReport remembers each client's numbers and your branding, so next week's report can be compared with the previous one from a single message. It can also draft the cover email.
payload.longDescription:
ClientReport是面向代理机构和自由职业者的数据分析和报告工具：它分析业绩数据并将其转化为品牌化PDF报告提供给客户。上传来自Google Analytics、Google Ads、Meta、Shopify、HubSpot的导出文件或任何CSV文件，或直接输入本周的数据。

ClientReport会自动识别日期列和核心指标，按周（或日/月）进行数据分组，并将当前周期数据与上一周期进行对比。生成的PDF包含KPI卡片展示周环比变化（能识别成本下降是积极信号）、趋势图表、通俗语言总结、重点亮点和下一步建议，所有内容均采用您机构的名称、Logo和品牌色系。

登录后，ClientReport会保存每个客户的数值数据和品牌信息，使下周报告能通过单条消息实现与前一周数据的对比。它还能自动生成报告封面邮件。

payload.name: SingStat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore official Singapore economic, population, household, industry, trade, and social statistics. Find relevant SingStat tables, inspect metadata, retrieve data, and compare figures with citations to the source tables and periods.
payload.longDescription: 探索官方的新加坡经济、人口、家庭、行业、贸易和社会统计数据。您可查找相关SingStat表格，查看元数据，获取数据，并对比数据并引用来源表及统计时段。

payload.name: Kracey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kracey computes running and HYROX race predictions, HYROX pacing targets, and comparisons between your saved HYROX races. Estimate a finish time from a running result, work back from a HYROX goal to lap and station times, or see where time changed between races. You can also review your training volume, best running efforts and session pace-zone minutes, and find upcoming HYROX and hybrid fitness races. A Kracey account is required. Personal training views need training data connected to Kracey through intervals.icu; calculators work from the numbers you provide. The plugin reads only your connected account and changes nothing. Predictions are estimates, not guaranteed results.
payload.longDescription: Kracey可计算跑步数据和HYROX比赛预测、HYROX配速目标，并对比您保存的HYROX赛事数据。根据跑步成绩预估完赛时间，从HYROX目标倒推单圈和站点用时，或查看赛事间时间变化情况。您还可以查看训练总量、最佳跑步表现和训练课时配速区间分钟数，寻找即将举行的HYROX及混合型健身赛事。需要Kracey账户。个人训练视图需通过intervals.icu将训练数据连接至Kracey；计算器仅根据您提供的数据运算。插件仅读取已连接账户数据，不进行任何修改。预测结果仅为估算，非保证性结果。

payload.name: CompSniper
payload.description: 真实 eBay 卖出价格
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CompSniper shows what items have actually sold for on eBay. Ask about any product and get recent completed sales with sold price, shipping, condition and sale date, plus a price summary: median, typical range and number of sales. Results filter out accessories and mismatched listings. You can price several items at once, compare products side by side, compare prices across eight eBay marketplaces (US, UK, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, Canada and Australia), check current eBay asking prices, and look up Mercari US listings. Useful for sourcing inventory, valuing a collection, or pricing an item to sell. Requires a CompSniper account; each search uses one search from your monthly CompSniper quota.
payload.longDescription: CompSniper 展示 eBay 上商品的实际成交价格。询问任何产品即可获取最近的成交记录，包含成交价格、运费、商品状况和成交日期，并附有价格摘要：中位数、常规区间和成交数量。结果会过滤掉配件和不匹配的列表。您可同时定价多个商品，对比产品参数，跨八个 eBay 市场（美国、英国、德国、法国、意大利、西班牙、加拿大和澳大利亚）比价，查看当前 eBay 市场报价，并查询 Mercari 美国市场列表。适用于采购库存、评估收藏价值或定价待售商品。需要 CompSniper 账户；每次搜索会消耗您每月 CompSniper 配额中的一次搜索次数。

payload.name: Adzviser Google Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Google Analytics 4 data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to understand how people find your site and what they do once they arrive.
