Compare active users, new users, sessions, engagement, and conversions across date ranges. Break results down by channel, session source and medium, landing page, device, or country. Turn your analytics into clear reports, spot traffic trends, and see which sources actually convert.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将Google Analytics 4数据连接到ChatGPT，用自然语言提问以了解用户如何找到你的网站以及他们到达后的行为。

在不同日期范围内对比活跃用户、新用户、会话量、参与度和转化率，按渠道、会话来源及媒介、着陆页、设备或国家细分结果，将分析结果转化为清晰的报告，发现流量趋势，并查看哪些来源真正带来转化。

payload.name: StringSpec
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StringSpec puts the measurements of nearly 800 tennis strings inside ChatGPT. Every string was tested on the same machine under the same protocol, so the numbers compare fairly: string bed stiffness, how much tension it loses, how much energy it returns, spin potential, ball bite, string friction and how far it stretches under load. Each figure comes with its percentile across the whole database, so "is this soft?" has a real answer.

Ask about one string and get every measurement, an estimated playable life, a tension adjustment versus your usual, and how it ranks for spin, comfort, control, power, tension hold, durability and feel. Compare two or three strings side by side. Describe what you want and your racquet (string pattern, head size, frame stiffness) and get a ranked shortlist with the reason each string fits, using the same finder as stringspec.com. Search and sort the database by brand, material, gauge, any measurement or price.

Answers keep measurements and estimates apart, carry a retailer's set price with the date it was checked, and link the string's page on stringspec.com for the full charts. Every tool is read-only and no account is needed.
payload.longDescription:
StringSpec将近800种网球线的测量数据整合到ChatGPT中。每根球线都在相同机器上按照统一协议测试，因此数据之间具有公平的可比性：包括球床刚度、张力衰减程度、能量回馈率、旋转潜力、击球咬合度、球线摩擦力以及承重拉伸距离。每个数据指标都附带全数据库的百分位数，因此「这根球线柔软吗？」这样的问题能得到真实答案。

询问某根球线即可获得所有测量数据、预估使用寿命、与您常用张力的调整建议，以及该球线在旋转性能、舒适度、控制性、力量、张力保持力、耐用性和手感方面的排名。可同时对比两到三根球线。描述您想要的特性及球拍参数（穿线模式、拍头尺寸、拍框刚度），将获得按优先级排序的短名单，说明每根球线的适配理由（使用与stringspec.com相同的筛选逻辑）。按品牌、材质、线径、任何测量数据或价格搜索和排序数据库。

所有回答会明确区分测量数据与估算值，显示零售商定价及核查日期，并链接至stringspec.com的球线详情页查看完整图表。所有工具均为只读模式，无需账户即可使用。

payload.name: Data to Chart
payload.description: 将数据转化为视觉故事
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create charts and data carousels from your tables. Includes 24 chart examples and eight editable carousel examples, all with fictional data.

Create a chart from a supplied CSV table, edit it inside the conversation and download PNG or SVG. Convert the same data into an editable carousel without leaving the editor, or provide a custom sequence of up to eight slides. Switching modes preserves the chart and slide edits.

Edit titles, slide text, sources, author and caption. Choose portrait 1080×1350 or square 1080×1080 for slides. Download a PDF with one page per slide, or a ZIP with numbered PNG/SVG files and an editable project. Tool credit on slides is optional. Save the complete workspace as JSON named with the project title and local date/time, including seconds.

The rendering service processes the table and does not store projects. Short workspaces can be shared through links that contain all project data; larger projects use JSON. Existing chart image links remain supported.

Limits: 20,000 CSV characters, 500 rows per standalone chart, 1–8 slides and 24 rows per slide chart. Pie/donut slides accept up to 8 non-negative categories with a positive total. Files use Montserrat and grayscale. PDF pages are rasterized at 1080 pixels wide. The editor is in Brazilian Portuguese. Changing data does not rewrite slide claims or captions: review them before publishing. The app does not verify sources, predict reach or publish to social networks.
payload.longDescription:
从表格创建图表和数据轮播
包含24个图表示例和8个可编辑轮播示例，所有数据均为虚构

从提供的CSV表格创建图表，在对话中编辑后下载PNG或SVG格式
无需离开编辑器即可将相同数据转换为可编辑轮播，或提供最多8张幻灯片的自定义序列
切换模式会保留图表和幻灯片编辑内容

编辑标题、幻灯片文字、来源、作者和说明
选择竖版1080×1350或方形1080×1080尺寸
下载每页一张幻灯片的PDF，或包含编号PNG/SVG文件和可编辑项目的ZIP包
幻灯片可选显示工具水印
将完整工作区保存为以项目标题和本地日期时间命名的JSON文件，包含秒级精度

渲染服务会处理表格数据但不会存储项目
短工作区可通过包含所有项目数据的链接分享；大型项目使用JSON格式
现有图表图片链接仍受支持

限制条件：20,000个CSV字符，单个图表最多500行，1-8张幻灯片，每张幻灯片24行
饼图/环图幻灯片支持最多8个非负分类且总和为正数
文件使用Montserrat字体和灰度模式
PDF页面以1080像素宽度位图化
编辑器界面为巴西葡萄牙语
修改数据不会重写幻灯片声明或说明：发布前请检查
该应用不验证来源、预测传播范围或发布到社交媒体

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create standalone PNG/SVG charts, Convert charts to editable carousels, Export PDF and PNG/SVG ZIP, Save and share complete editable projects

payload.name: ThriveStack Citedby
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: See how AI search engines mention and cite your brand, how you compare with competitors, and what to publish next. Connect your ThriveStack account to ask questions about your brand's AI visibility, citations, competitors and recommendations in plain language. Access is limited to the brands in your own ThriveStack account. Every tool only reads your data, except saving content recommendations, which happens only when you ask. Requires a ThriveStack Citedby account.
payload.longDescription:
查看AI搜索引擎如何提及和引用您的品牌、与竞争对手的对比情况，以及下一步应发布的内容。
连接您的ThriveStack账户，以自然语言询问关于品牌AI可见性、引用、竞争对手和推荐的问题。
仅限访问您自己ThriveStack账户中的品牌数据。
每个工具仅读取您的数据，保存内容推荐的操作仅在您主动请求时才会发生。
需要ThriveStack Citedby账户。

payload.name: Plushcap
payload.description: 开发者与人工智能趋势
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Plushcap provides content research and analytics for technical marketing teams. Use it to analyze developer and AI topic trends, compare competitors' publishing activity, and find sources for content planning. Search engineering blog posts, YouTube videos, and X posts indexed by Plushcap; compare companies and competitive spaces; and inspect Hacker News attention and historical trend metrics with links to sources. Requires a Plushcap account and authorization. Available sources, history, and usage limits depend on your account's plan. The integration is read-only; indexed coverage may be incomplete or delayed.
payload.longDescription: Plushcap 为技术营销团队提供内容研究与分析服务。可用于分析开发者与人工智能主题趋势、比较竞争对手的发布活动，并为内容规划寻找来源。搜索 Plushcap 索引的工程博客文章、YouTube 视频和 X 平台帖子；比较公司及竞争领域；并通过链接查看 Hacker News 的关注度及历史趋势指标。需要 Plushcap 账户和授权。可用资源、历史记录和使用限制取决于您的账户计划。该集成为只读模式；索引覆盖可能不完整或存在延迟。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Research developer trends, Compare competitor content, Analyze content activity

payload.name: FieldScore
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FieldScore gives you direct access to data on every agricultural field in Denmark.

Ask about crops, field sizes, soil types, organic status, crop rotation history, livestock holdings, drought exposure and field geometry, for a single farm, a municipality or the whole country. The data comes from the Danish Agricultural Agency's field maps, the Central Business Register (CVR), the Central Husbandry Register (CHR) and the Danish Meteorological Institute, enriched with FieldScore's own agronomic scoring.

Everything is read-only. The connector can query and analyse, but never changes anything in your account or in any public register.

Requires a FieldScore account with a Pro or Team subscription.
payload.longDescription:
FieldScore为您提供丹麦所有农田的数据直接访问权限。

您可以查询单个农场、市镇或整个国家的作物信息、田地面积、土壤类型、有机状态、轮作历史、畜牧持有量、干旱暴露度及田地几何形状。这些数据源自丹麦农业局的田地图、中央企业注册处（CVR）、中央畜牧注册处（CHR）和丹麦气象局数据，并结合FieldScore自有的农学评分系统进行增强。

所有数据均为只读模式。连接器仅能进行查询和分析，无法修改您的账户或任何公共记录中的内容。

需要拥有FieldScore的Pro版或团队版订阅账户。

payload.name: Precip - Hyperlocal Weather
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Precip answers weather questions with precise, accurate data. It returns detailed weather forecasts, rainfall totals, minute-by-minute precipitation for the next hour, snow depth, and soil moisture and temperature. Coverage is the United States and Canada.

Ask about a saved location by name, or give a latitude and longitude. The assistant can list locations on the account and save a new one when asked.
payload.longDescription:
Precip通过精准可靠的数据显示天气问题。
它提供详细的天气预报、降雨总量、未来一小时的逐分钟降水情况、积雪深度以及土壤湿度和温度数据。
服务范围覆盖美国和加拿大地区。

可通过名称询问已保存的位置信息，或提供纬度和经度坐标。
助手可列出账户中的所有位置信息，并在用户要求时保存新的位置数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Weather forecasts, Minute-by-minute nowcast, Rainfall totals, Snow depth, Soil moisture and temperature, Saved locations

payload.name: conclusia
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: conclusia builds and maintains company lists: target lists, market longlists, add-on candidates. Use it whenever the user wants a list of companies built, asks what lists they have, or wants a list filtered, researched or exported to Excel - and whenever they mention conclusia. Behind the endpoint works conclusia's own autonomous system: it turns a brief into explicit criteria, pulls candidates from a base of millions of active companies, and validates each one with live web evidence. It works on the user's own conclusia account.
payload.longDescription: conclusia负责构建和维护公司清单，包括目标清单、市场长名单和附加候选公司。当用户需要生成公司清单、查询已有清单、要求对清单进行筛选/调研/导出至Excel时，或提及conclusia时，均可使用该功能。该功能基于conclusia自主系统运行：它能将简要需求转化为明确标准，从数百万家活跃企业数据库中提取候选公司，并通过实时网络证据验证每个候选对象有效性。该系统依托用户的conclusia账户运行。

payload.name: Offplan Insider
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Offplan Insider is a property data tool for researching off-plan (under-construction) homes in the UAE. It gives you searchable project data and market statistics for Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ras Al Khaimah and Umm Al Quwain: prices, payment plans, handover dates and developer details.

What you can do:
- Search projects by emirate, area, developer, budget, bedrooms, property type, handover year and payment plan.
- See a project's starting prices by unit type, payment plan milestones, handover date, location, amenities and current developer offers.
- Compare two to four projects side by side.
- Turn a payment plan into an instalment schedule in AED.
- Get current market figures, such as median entry prices by emirate and by bedroom count.
- Ask an Offplan Insider adviser to contact you, if you choose to share your name and phone number.

Every result links to the matching page on offplaninsider.com and shows when the data was last verified with the developer. Pre-launch projects that the developer has not yet confirmed are labelled as such.

Limitations: prices are published starting prices and availability changes quickly, so confirm details before you commit. Offplan Insider does not give personalised investment, legal, tax or mortgage advice. Offplan Insider is paid by developers as their marketing partner.
payload.longDescription:
Offplan Insider 是一款用于研究阿联酋期房（在建）住宅的房产数据工具。该工具提供迪拜、阿布扎比、沙迦、拉斯海马和乌姆盖万的可搜索项目数据和市场统计数据：包括价格、付款计划、交房日期和开发商信息。

您可以：
- 按酋长国、区域、开发商、预算、卧室数量、房产类型、交房年份和付款计划搜索项目。
- 查看项目的起始价格（按单元类型）、付款计划节点、交房日期、位置、配套设施及当前开发商优惠。
- 同时对比2-4个项目。
- 将付款计划转换为阿迪尔迪拉姆（AED）分期付款安排。
- 获取当前市场数据，例如按酋长国和卧室数量划分的中位数入门价格。
- 选择提供姓名和电话号码，让Offplan Insider顾问与您联系。

每个搜索结果都会链接到对应的官网页面，并显示数据最后一次与开发商核实的时间。开发商尚未确认的预售前项目会特别标注。

限制说明：价格为公布起始价，且房源信息可能快速变动，请在做出承诺前确认详细信息。Offplan Insider 不提供个性化投资、法律、税务或抵押贷款建议。Offplan Insider 作为开发商的营销合作伙伴获取报酬。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search off-plan projects, Project details and payment plans, Compare projects, Market figures, Adviser call back on request

payload.name: Presentation Builder
payload.description: 将数据转化为幻灯片演示文稿
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Presentation Builder helps you turn data into clear, professional presentations. Share your numbers, a table or a report, and it analyzes the figures, recommends the best chart for each insight and writes slides that lead with the key takeaway, complete with speaker notes.

What you can do:
- Analyze your data: get totals, averages, changes over time, trends, rankings, shares of total, outliers and correlations, calculated from the numbers you provide.
- Choose the right chart: get a recommended chart type, such as line, column, bar, donut or scatter, with a short explanation and design tips.
- Write insight headlines: get draft headlines that state what the data shows, such as growth rates, top performers and the biggest changes.
- Build complete presentations: create business reviews, KPI updates, pitch decks, sales decks and report summaries from a single prompt.
- Improve existing slides: get a scored review with specific fixes, or have your slides shortened, simplified, rewritten or translated.
- Prepare to present: get speaker notes, timed scripts, likely audience questions with suggested answers, and delivery tips.

Who it is for: analysts, managers, founders, consultants, and finance, marketing and sales teams who present data and need clear slides quickly.

Limitations: Presentation Builder analyzes only the numbers you share in the conversation (up to 200 data points and 10 series per analysis). It does not connect to databases, spreadsheets or other data sources, and its calculations describe your data rather than forecast it. Data sent to the analysis tool is processed in memory and is not stored. Slides are delivered as text with design guidance; downloadable files are created only when file creation is available in your chat.

Every response ends with a short footer that includes an affiliate link and an affiliate disclosure.
payload.longDescription:
Presentation Builder能帮助您将数据转化为清晰专业的演示文稿。分享您的数据、表格或报告，它将分析数据数值，为每个洞察推荐最佳图表类型，并撰写以核心结论为亮点的幻灯片内容，完整包含演讲者备注。

您可以实现以下操作：
- 分析您的数据：获取您提供数据的总计、平均值、时间变化、趋势、排名、总体占比、异常值和相关性等分析结果。
- 选择合适的图表：获得如折线图、柱状图、条形图、环形图或散点图等推荐图表类型，并附带简要说明和设计建议。
- 撰写洞察标题：获取描述数据表现的标题草案，例如增长速率、表现最佳项和最大变化项等。
- 构建完整演示文稿：通过单一指令创建业务回顾、KPI更新、路演演示文稿、销售演示文稿和报告摘要。
- 优化现有幻灯片：获得评分评审及具体修改建议，或对幻灯片进行精简、简化、重写或翻译处理。
- 准备演讲内容：获取演讲者备注、定时脚本、可能的观众提问及建议答案，以及演讲技巧建议。

适用人群：需要快速制作清晰幻灯片的分析师、经理、创始人、顾问，以及从事财务、市场和销售工作的数据呈现人员。

使用限制：Presentation Builder仅分析对话中分享的数据（每次分析最多200个数据点和10个数据系列）。它不连接数据库、电子表格或其他数据源，其计算仅描述您的数据而非进行预测。发送至分析工具的数据在内存中处理且不存储。幻灯片以文本形式呈现并附带设计指引；仅当聊天界面支持文件创建时才会生成可下载文件。

每个回复结尾均包含包含附属链接和附属披露的简短页脚。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Analyze data for slides, Recommend chart types, Write insight headlines, Build complete presentations, Improve existing slides, Write speaker notes and scripts

payload.name: Signal by StackEnhance
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Signal by StackEnhance answers questions about how often ecommerce brands send marketing email. It draws on StackEnhance Signal's archive of marketing emails from 750+ online stores, mostly in Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland and Germany. Ask how many emails a brand sent in a month, what it sent last week, how often it currently emails its customers, or which brands in a market email the most. Every answer links to the brand's public page on stackenhance.com, where the deeper analysis lives. Counts are de-duplicated marketing sends; welcome, birthday and transactional emails are excluded. For a recent period the app lists the send dates and may quote up to two subject lines that are already public on the brand's page; the full campaigns, all subject lines, offers and creative analysis stay in Signal. Signal has no open, click or revenue data. Read-only; no account needed.
payload.longDescription: 由StackEnhance推出的Signal工具可解答电商品牌发送营销邮件的频率问题。该工具基于StackEnhance Signal收录的750余家线上商店的营销邮件档案，这些店铺主要位于瑞典、挪威、丹麦、芬兰和德国。您可以查询某个品牌一个月内发送了多少封邮件、上周具体发送了什么内容、当前对客户的发送频率，或是了解某个市场中发送邮件最频繁的品牌。每个回答都会链接至品牌在stackenhance.com的公开页面，更深入的分析内容也均存放于此。统计数字为去重后的营销发送次数，欢迎邮件、生日邮件和交易邮件不计入统计。对于近期周期，该应用会列出发送日期，并可能引用品牌页面上已公开的最多两个邮件主题行；完整的活动内容、所有主题行、优惠信息和创意分析仍保留在Signal中。Signal不包含任何开放率、点击率或营收数据，为只读工具，无需账户即可使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up a brand's email frequency, List a brand's recent sends, Rank brands in a market

payload.name: RallyIQ
payload.description: 网球比赛策略与情报分析
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
RallyIQ puts a tennis scouting desk inside ChatGPT. It is built on the Match Charting Project, where volunteers have recorded every shot of more than 11,000 professional matches: serve direction, stroke, direction, return depth and how each point ended. RallyIQ turns those charts into a model of what each shot is worth, so it can say not only what a player does but what it gains them.

Ask for a game plan and get a forecast with a 90% range, where to aim first serves on each court against that returner, which returns work against that server, the rally shots to favour and avoid, and the charted head-to-heads. Ask about one player for serve and return strength against an average opponent, shot ratings for direction choice and execution, first-serve habits on break points, how readable the serve is, and the shots they are most exposed to. Ask why a charted match went the way it did and get each player's gains and leaks by stroke and by set. Leaderboards rank players on direction choice, execution, serve exploitability and long rallies.

Every number comes with its uncertainty and a link to the full page on RallyIQ. The shot data is licensed CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and every answer credits the Match Charting Project. Every tool is read-only and no account is needed.
payload.longDescription:
RallyIQ将网球情报分析功能嵌入ChatGPT。该工具基于Match Charting Project项目，志愿者已完整记录超过11000场职业比赛的每个击球数据：发球方向、击球类型、回球深度以及每个回合的结束方式。RallyIQ将这些图表转化为击球价值模型，不仅能说明选手的击球行为，还能分析这些击球带来的实际收益。

请求比赛策略可获得包含90%置信区间的预测方案，包括：面对特定回球选手时首发出球的瞄准区域、针对该发球选手的有效回球策略、应优先选择和避免的相持阶段击球方式，以及历史交锋数据图表。查询选手发球与接发球强度时，可获得其面对平均对手时的击球方向选择评分与执行质量评分、关键分首发出球习惯、发球可读性分析以及最易被攻击的击球类型。分析已记录比赛的走势时，可获取双方选手在各回合中的得分优势与漏洞分析。排行榜功能可对选手的方向选择能力、击球执行质量、发球被针对可能性以及相持回合能力进行排名。

所有数据均附带不确定性说明，并链接至RallyIQ的完整分析页面。击球数据采用CC BY-NC-SA 4.0协议授权，每个分析结果均标注来源：Match Charting Project。所有工具均为只读模式，无需账户即可使用。

payload.name: PropertyRadar
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research U.S. markets and prospects conversationally using PropertyRadar's property and people data. Resolve an address, inspect Property details, transactions, comparable sales, ownership and contact information, discover supported Criteria and fields, search for matching Properties, and save selected results as a dynamic Audience. PropertyRadar accesses only the data available to your connected account.
payload.longDescription: 通过PropertyRadar的房产和人员数据，以对话方式研究美国市场和前景。定位地址，查看房产详情、交易记录、比较销售、所有权及联系方式，发现支持的条件和字段，搜索匹配房产，并将选定结果保存为动态受众。PropertyRadar仅访问与您的账户连接的数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Discover property search Criteria, Preview property counts and aggregate signals, Resolve U.S. property addresses, Inspect property records and public-record history, Save dynamic Audiences with confirmation

payload.name: SARA by Aitomic
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
SARA is a retail operations platform for independent retailers. Connect your SARA account to ChatGPT and ask about your business in plain English: open purchase orders, overdue invoices, claims, vendor performance, inventory across Shopify, Square, Clover and Lightspeed, and your open-to-buy budget.

You can also have ChatGPT make routine updates for you: set reminders, add or edit notes on orders and invoices, change an order's ship date, and file or withdraw a vendor claim, with an optional photo. Every change is drafted first. You see exactly what will be saved, and nothing is saved until you confirm.

Sign in with your regular SARA email and password. The plugin only sees your own retailer account. It needs an active SARA account. It does not pay invoices, send email to vendors, or change vendor contact details.
payload.longDescription:
SARA是独立零售商的零售运营平台。
将您的SARA账户连接到ChatGPT，用日常英语询问您的业务相关问题：未完成的采购订单、逾期发票、索赔、供应商表现、跨Shopify、Square、Clover和Lightspeed的库存，以及您的采购预算。

您还可以让ChatGPT为您处理常规操作：设置提醒，为订单和发票添加或编辑备注，修改订单的发货日期，并可选附上照片提交或撤回供应商索赔。
每次更改都会先生成草稿。
您将看到确切的保存内容，且在您确认前不会实际保存任何内容。

使用您的常规SARA邮箱和密码登录。
插件仅能看到您自己的零售商账户。
需要有效的SARA账户。
不会支付发票、向供应商发送邮件或修改供应商联系方式。

payload.name: Otter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect your Otter account to manage website A/B tests and understand experiment results. Find projects, check installation instructions, inspect pages for visual changes, create redirect or visual experiment drafts, manage experiment status, and read results. Results use Otter's server-side statistical interpretation, including Bayesian and frequentist analysis. You choose which Otter account to connect and approve its permissions; access remains limited by your current role. An active Otter account is required. Website changes require the Otter SDK to be installed. Creating a draft does not launch it. You can revoke the connection from Otter's Connected apps page.
payload.longDescription: 连接您的Otter账户以管理网站A/B测试并理解实验结果。查找项目、查看安装说明、检查页面的视觉变化、创建重定向或视觉实验草稿、管理实验状态并阅读实验结果。实验结果采用Otter的服务器端统计分析，包括贝叶斯分析和频率学派分析。您可选择连接哪个Otter账户并批准其权限；访问权限仍受您当前角色限制。需要有效的Otter账户。网站变更需安装Otter SDK。创建草稿不会启动实验。您可从Otter的已连接应用页面撤销连接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Manage projects, Create experiment drafts, Inspect website pages, Analyze experiment results

payload.name: Adzviser Shopify
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Shopify store data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to track sales, see what's selling, and understand how your store is performing over time.

Compare gross sales, returns, discounts, shipping, and taxes across date ranges. Break results down by product, SKU, order, or customer. Turn your store data into clear reports, spot trends, and see which products and periods are driving revenue.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将您的Shopify店铺数据连接到ChatGPT。使用通俗语言提问以跟踪销售情况，查看热销产品，并了解店铺随时间的表现。

跨日期范围比较总销售额、退货、折扣、运费和税费。按产品、SKU、订单或客户分解结果。将店铺数据转化为清晰报告，发现趋势，查看哪些产品和时段在推动收入。

payload.name: RefreshAgent
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: RefreshAgent analyzes your live Google Search Console and Google Analytics data to diagnose SEO performance and identify what to improve next. It can compare organic-search performance over time, find winning and losing pages, surface content decay and CTR opportunities, research competing pages, assess information gain, and guide evidence-backed SEO improvements. RefreshAgent only accesses data available to the connected account. Public-web research is used for explicit competitor and information-gain workflows. Write tools can change connected WordPress SEO state and should only be used when the user asks for that change.
payload.longDescription: RefreshAgent通过分析实时的Google搜索控制台和Google Analytics数据，诊断SEO表现并确定下一步优化方向。它能够对比不同时期的自然搜索表现，发现表现优异和不佳的页面，揭示内容衰减和CTR提升机会，研究竞争页面，评估信息增量，并指导基于证据的SEO优化。RefreshAgent仅访问已连接账户可访问的数据。针对显式竞争对手和信息增量工作流，会使用公开网络研究。撰写工具可修改已连接的WordPress SEO状态，且仅在用户明确要求更改时使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Console data, Analytics data, SEO diagnostics, Information-gain research, WordPress SEO workflows

payload.name: Rival Ads
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Rival Ads workspace to explore tracked competitor ads across Meta, Google, TikTok and LinkedIn. Read available ad copy, OCR, transcripts and strategy analyses; organize projects and saved ads; request monitor syncs; and manage client report links.

Requires a Rival Ads account and workspace-owner access. Existing plan limits and collection schedules apply. Results reflect stored public ad-library observations, which may be incomplete or delayed. Rival Ads does not manage advertising campaigns or provide competitors’ private spend, clicks or conversion data. Source availability and creative coverage vary by channel and country.
payload.longDescription:
将您的Rival Ads工作区连接至Meta、Google、TikTok和LinkedIn，探索跟踪的竞品广告。可阅读广告文案、OCR识别内容、转录文本及策略分析；管理项目和保存的广告；请求监控同步；以及维护客户报告链接。

需要Rival Ads账户及工作区管理员权限。适用现有计划限制和数据收集时间表。结果基于存储的公开广告库观察数据，可能存在不完整或延迟情况。Rival Ads不负责管理广告活动，也不提供竞争对手的私有投放数据、点击量或转化数据。数据来源和创意覆盖范围因渠道和国家而异。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Explore tracked competitor ads, Read existing strategy analyses, Organize saved ad research, Manage monitors and projects, Request and check monitor syncs, Manage client report links

payload.name: Shoptegrity
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Shoptegrity helps you shop with integrity. Ask about a brand, a store, or a whole shopping list and see who owns it and where the money goes, with a linked source for every fact, or a plain "withheld" when there isn't one.

What you can do:
- Find independent sellers for a product or gift, within your budget
- Check a sale price against the prices Shoptegrity has recorded daily, and see when a price was raised before the "discount"
- See price drops on products Shoptegrity tracks
- Check a cart or gift list to learn which company is behind each item, using SEC filings where they exist
- Find local businesses, co-ops, farmers markets and credit unions near a ZIP code or town, where Shoptegrity has listings
- Browse employee-owned, cooperative, credit-union, B Corp and family-owned alternatives, each with its source
- Get a plan for Black Friday, Small Business Saturday, Cyber Monday, Giving Tuesday and holiday gifts

Results are never ordered by commission. Grades and ratings are Shoptegrity's opinion under a published methodology. No account is needed, and the tools only need a brand, product or place name.
payload.longDescription:
Shoptegrity帮助您以诚信的方式购物。
询问某个品牌、商店或整个购物清单，查看其所有者以及资金流向，每个事实都附有来源链接，没有来源时则显示「未披露」。

您可以：
- 在预算范围内查找产品的独立卖家或礼物供应商
- 将促销价格与Shoptegrity每日记录的价格对比，查看「折扣」前价格是否已上涨
- 查看Shoptegrity追踪产品的价格下跌情况
- 检查购物车或礼物清单，通过SEC文件了解每个商品背后的公司
- 根据ZIP码或城镇查找本地企业、合作社、农贸市场和信用社（Shoptegrity有相关名录）
- 浏览员工持股、合作社、信用社、B Corp和家族企业等替代选项，每个选项均附有来源信息
- 获取黑色星期五、小企业周六、网络星期一、慈善星期二及节日礼物的购物计划

结果从不按佣金排序。
评分和评级是Shoptegrity基于公开方法论得出的主观意见。
无需账户，工具仅需品牌、产品或地点名称即可使用。

payload.name: ZOVA
payload.description: 为经纪人提供的房产数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ZOVA brings a broker's property research into ChatGPT. Ask about an address and ZOVA returns the parcel record (size, year built, assessed value, last recorded sale, zoning, flood zone), the owner, recent comparable sales, the county housing market and economy, and neighborhood scores, each figure with its source and date. It also reads the analyses you have run in ZOVA and runs ZOVA's deal math on numbers you give it: income-property underwriting, rental returns and a seller net sheet for Florida and Georgia.

For brokers and investors with a ZOVA account. You sign in with that account when you connect.

Limitations: ZOVA only reads data; it does not list, buy, message or change anything. Property lookups work for addresses ZOVA has already seen and for parcel IDs, and parcel-level records are deepest in Florida and Georgia. For an individual owner ZOVA returns only the owner type and portfolio size, never the name or mailing address. When a figure is missing, ZOVA says so rather than estimating it. ZOVA does not see your ChatGPT conversation, only the requests ChatGPT sends to it.
payload.longDescription:
ZOVA将经纪人的房产研究带入ChatGPT。输入地址后，ZOVA将返回地块记录（面积、建成年份、评估价值、最近成交记录、用地类型、洪水区）、业主信息、近期可比成交数据、县住房市场及经济情况，以及社区评分，每个数据项都会标注来源和日期。它还能读取你在ZOVA中运行的分析，并对您提供的数字执行ZOVA的交易计算：收入型物业承销、租金回报率计算，以及佛罗里达州和佐治亚州的卖方净收入表

需要ZOVA账户的经纪人和投资者。连接时需使用该账户登录

限制条件：ZOVA仅读取数据；它不会列出、购买、发送消息或更改任何内容。房产查询支持ZOVA已收录的地址和地块编号，地块级记录在佛罗里达州和佐治亚州最为详尽。对于单个业主，ZOVA仅显示业主类型和持仓规模，不会显示姓名或邮寄地址。当某项数据缺失时，ZOVA会明确说明而非进行估算。ZOVA无法查看你的ChatGPT对话，仅能接收ChatGPT发送的请求

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Property records, Ownership, Sales comps, County market data, Your ZOVA analyses, Deal math

payload.name: Adzviser Meta Ads
payload.summaryOriginal: Talk to your Facebook Ads data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Facebook and Instagram ads data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to analyze campaign performance, track spending, and understand your return on ad spend.

Compare campaigns, ad sets, and individual ads across date ranges. Explore metrics like impressions, clicks, cost per result, and conversions. Turn your data into clear reports, spot performance trends, and identify opportunities to improve your advertising.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将您的Facebook和Instagram广告数据连接至ChatGPT。用自然语言提问以分析广告系列表现、追踪支出并了解广告支出回报率。

跨日期范围比较广告系列、广告组及单个广告。探索展示次数、点击量、每次结果成本和转化率等指标。将数据转化为清晰报告，发现表现趋势，并识别提升广告效果的机会。

payload.name: HYPD.AI for Keyword Research
payload.description: 为付费搜索找到关键词
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Research keywords, compare available metrics and forecast ad traffic for paid search campaigns.

To use keyword research, connect an eligible Google Ads account through HYPD. This connection provides access to Keyword Planner estimates; data availability depends on account permissions and coverage.

What you can do:

Find keyword ideas: Start with one or more seed keywords and get related keyword suggestions with available metrics.

Get search volumes: Review monthly search volume, CPC, competition, top-of-page bid ranges and available 12-month trends for up to 500 keywords at once.

Forecast ad traffic: Estimate impressions, clicks, CTR, average CPC and cost for your keywords using a selected maximum CPC bid and match type.

Research individual countries and languages to explore local markets. Sort results by volume, competition or bids, and navigate large keyword sets using pagination.
payload.longDescription:
研究关键词，比较可用指标并预测付费搜索活动的广告流量

要使用关键词研究功能，需通过HYPD连接符合条件的Google Ads账户。此连接可访问关键词规划师预估数据；数据可用性取决于账户权限和覆盖范围。

您可以执行以下操作：

获取关键词创意：从一个或多个种子关键词开始，获取相关关键词建议及可用指标

获取搜索量数据：一次查看最多500个关键词的月度搜索量、每次点击费用、竞争度、首页出价范围及12个月趋势数据

预测广告流量：通过选择最大每次点击费用出价和匹配类型，预估关键词的展示次数、点击量、点击率、平均每次点击费用及成本

研究单个国家和语言以探索本地市场。按搜索量、竞争度或出价对结果排序，并通过分页功能浏览大量关键词集合。

payload.name: Lupper
payload.description: 邮件结果呈现在聊天中
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Show email campaign results from Lupper in ChatGPT, with opens, clicks, and revenue per campaign, and a plain summary of current and earlier results. Compare one period with the previous one. List onsite campaigns and flows. Save an email draft as blocks in the visual editor, with a subject and an optional segment. You can also look up profiles, segments, orders, and events for the companies you allow. SMS campaign results are not included. The connection does not send campaigns or publish onsite.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中展示Lupper的电子邮件活动结果，包括每封邮件的打开数、点击数及创收情况，并提供当前及历史结果的简洁总结。对比当前周期与上一周期的数据，列出站内活动及流程。可将邮件草稿保存为可视化编辑器中的区块，包含主题和可选的受众群体。您还可以查看所授权公司的用户档案、受众群体、订单及事件信息。不包含短信活动结果，该连接不会发送活动或在站内发布。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Show email campaign results, Compare results over time, Summarize what worked, List onsite campaigns, Create email drafts

payload.name: GoVISIBLE
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
GoVISIBLE measures how brands appear in AI-generated answers from tracked AI engines. This plugin connects your GoVISIBLE account so you can ask about your tracked brands in plain language.

What you can do:
- List your GoVISIBLE projects and view brand profiles, tracked competitors and AI engines.
- Get visibility, mention strength, sentiment and share of voice, overall or broken down by AI engine, date, cluster, journey stage, persona, intent or competitor.
- Analyse citations: which websites, pages, domains and content formats are cited for your topics.
- Drill into individual buyer prompts and review the raw AI answers behind the metrics.
- Generate a complete AI visibility audit report or a monthly report for a project.

Who it is for: marketing, SEO and GEO teams and agencies that already use GoVISIBLE.

Limitations: a GoVISIBLE account is required and you sign in with your GoVISIBLE email and password. The plugin is read-only. It cannot create projects, run new benchmarks, change settings or make purchases. It only returns data for the brands your account can access, and results reflect the most recent completed GoVISIBLE benchmark runs.
payload.longDescription:
GoVISIBLE通过跟踪的AI引擎测量品牌在AI生成答案中的呈现情况。该插件连接您的GoVISIBLE账户，使您能够以自然语言询问已跟踪品牌。

您可以：
- 列出您的GoVISIBLE项目并查看品牌资料、跟踪的竞争对手和AI引擎。
- 获取可见性、提及强度、情感倾向和语音份额，按AI引擎、日期、聚类、旅程阶段、用户画像、意图或竞争对手整体或分项查看。
- 分析引用来源：哪些网站、页面、域名和内容格式被引用于您的主题。
- 深入查看单个买家提示，审查指标背后原始的AI回答。
- 生成完整的AI可见性审计报告或项目的月度报告。

适用对象：已使用GoVISIBLE的市场、SEO和GEO团队及代理机构。

限制条件：需要GoVISIBLE账户，并使用GoVISIBLE邮箱和密码登录。
该插件为只读模式。
无法创建项目、运行新基准测试、更改设置或进行购买。
仅返回账户可访问的品牌数据，结果反映最近完成的GoVISIBLE基准测试运行结果。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: AI visibility analytics, Brand and competitor insights, Citation and source analysis, Sentiment and share of voice, Audit and monthly reports

payload.name: Blinkfire
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Blinkfire provides sports sponsorship and social media analytics for teams, leagues, brands, agencies, and other sports organizations. Find entities and posts; analyze audiences, engagement, sponsorship valuation, broadcast and in-stadium exposure; and compare performance through reports and benchmarks. You can also manage playlists, entity groups, inventory, proposals, and deals through the existing Blinkfire MCP tools. Requires a Blinkfire account and API access. Available data and actions depend on your account permissions, licensing, and server capabilities.
payload.longDescription: Blinkfire为球队、联盟、品牌、代理机构和其他体育组织提供体育赞助和社会媒体分析服务。查找实体和帖子；分析受众、参与度、赞助估值、广播和现场曝光；并通过报告和基准进行表现对比。您还可以通过现有的Blinkfire MCP工具管理播放列表、实体组、库存、提案和交易。需要Blinkfire账户和API访问权限。可用数据和操作取决于您的账户权限、许可协议和服务器能力。

payload.name: Le Confidant
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore communication patterns using quantitative statistics from an existing Le Confidant analysis you explicitly connect. Review message totals and participation, conversation starts, reply timing and sample sizes, and mean message length in a results card and explanation. Participants appear as A and B. Import and complete analysis on leconfidant.ai first, then authorize access in the browser that owns the session. The plugin cannot upload conversations, start analyses, compare periods or provide original messages, participant names, excerpts or semantic-analysis reports. Access ends at the earlier of the session expiry or authorization deadline. Disconnect to stop future reads; this does not delete the website session or results already shared in ChatGPT.
payload.longDescription:
通过显式连接的现有Le Confidant分析中的定量统计数据，探索沟通模式。
在结果卡片和说明中查看消息总量和参与度、对话开始次数、回复时间、样本数量以及平均消息长度。
参与者显示为A和B。
请先在leconfidant.ai导入并完成分析，然后在拥有该会话的浏览器中授权访问。
该插件无法上传对话内容、启动分析、对比时间段或提供原始消息、参与者姓名、摘录或语义分析报告。
访问权限在会话过期或授权截止时较早发生时终止。
断开连接可阻止未来读取；这不会删除网站会话或已分享至ChatGPT的结果。

payload.name: Applyra
payload.summaryOriginal: App Store and Google Play ASO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Applyra tracks how your apps rank on the App Store and Google Play every day. This plugin brings that data into the conversation, so the assistant answers from your own account instead of from memory.

Ask which keywords moved this month, and it reads your positions, the apps just ahead and behind you, and the rank history of each keyword. Ask whether a keyword is worth targeting, and it inspects its difficulty and traffic scores, its KEI and the apps ranking for it. Draft a new title, subtitle, short description or iOS keywords field, and Applyra checks it against each store's rules, then scores it on the same engine that audits live listings, so you see the gain or loss before you ship.

It also reads the ASO Health audit of a listing and the visibility score history of an app, compares your app with its competitors, runs store autocomplete and niche analyses, and reads the top charts of both stores. When you ask for it, it tracks or untracks keywords and competitors in your Applyra account.

Built for indie developers, solo founders and small studios who publish their own apps.

Your listings stay in your hands: Applyra reads and scores, and you publish the changes yourself in App Store Connect or the Google Play Console. You sign in with an Applyra account that includes API access.
payload.longDescription:
Applyra每天追踪您的应用在App Store和Google Play的排名。
此插件将这些数据引入对话中，因此助手会根据您的账户数据回答，而非仅凭记忆。

询问本月哪些关键词有变动时，它会读取您的排名、紧邻您前后的位置以及每个关键词的排名历史。
询问某个关键词是否值得优化时，它会分析其难度和流量评分、KEI值以及排名该关键词的应用程序。
撰写新的标题、副标题、简短描述或iOS关键词字段时，Applyra会根据各商店规则进行检查，然后使用与审核实时列表相同的引擎进行评分，让您在发布前就能看到潜在收益或损失。

它还能读取列表的ASO健康审计结果和应用的可见性评分历史，与竞争对手进行对比，执行商店自动补全和细分领域分析，并查看两个商店的排行榜。
当您要求时，它可以跟踪或取消跟踪Applyra账户中的关键词和竞争对手。

专为独立开发者、单人创始人和小型工作室设计，适用于自主发布应用的场景。

您的应用列表始终由您掌控：Applyra负责读取和评分，您可自行通过App Store Connect或Google Play Console发布更改。
您需要使用包含API访问权限的Applyra账户登录。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read keyword rankings and rank history, Inspect keyword difficulty and traffic, Audit a listing with ASO Health, Check and score draft listing text, Compare an app with its competitors, Run store autocomplete and niche analyses, Read App Store and Google Play top charts, Track keywords and competitors

payload.summaryOriginal: Talk to your Google Ads data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Google Ads data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to analyze campaign performance, track spending, and understand your return on ad spend.

Compare campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and individual ads across date ranges. Explore metrics like impressions, clicks, cost per click, conversions, and conversion value. Turn your data into clear reports, spot performance trends, and identify opportunities to improve your advertising.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将Google Ads数据连接至ChatGPT。用自然语言提问以分析广告活动表现，跟踪广告支出并了解广告支出回报率。

在日期范围之间对比广告活动、广告组、关键词和单个广告。探索展示次数、点击次数、每次点击费用、转化次数和转化价值等指标。将您的数据转化为清晰报告，发现表现趋势并识别广告优化机会。

payload.name: BlockSurvey
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Create and manage surveys in your BlockSurvey team workspace without leaving ChatGPT. Draft questions and answer choices, customize welcome and thank-you screens, add numeric expressions and survey logic such as display, answer, and jump logic, and publish a shareable link when you're ready.
payload.longDescription: 在无需离开ChatGPT的情况下，在您的BlockSurvey团队工作区中创建和管理调查。起草问题和答案选项，自定义欢迎屏幕和感谢页面，添加数值表达式和调查逻辑（如显示逻辑、答案逻辑和跳转逻辑），准备就绪后发布可共享链接。

payload.name: eRank
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Use eRank in ChatGPT to research what shoppers search for on Etsy and how listings and shops compare. Look up statistics for one keyword or compare up to 20 at once, find related searches, see which listings rank for a keyword, and explore Trend Buzz keyword trends by marketplace, country, and period. You can also read the keyword lists you've saved in eRank.

For the Etsy shops connected to your eRank account, you can review the current shop's profile and sales ranks, browse its listings with eRank Listing Audit grades, analyze a listing's tags, and check recent sales for the competitor shops you track in eRank. You can also look up the public summary and active listings of any Etsy shop by its exact name.

eRank learning resources, news, product updates, and your account's plan and remaining usage are available too.

What you can access depends on your eRank account. Some data and daily search allowances vary by plan, and results say when data isn't available on your plan or a daily limit has been reached. Information about other shops is limited to public Etsy data and eRank's research data. It never includes their private orders, customers, or account details.

When you ask, the plugin can change which of your connected shops is active in eRank. It doesn't create, edit, publish, or delete Etsy listings, and it doesn't change Etsy shop settings.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中使用eRank研究买家在Etsy上的搜索内容，以及商品列表和店铺的对比情况。可查找单个关键词的统计数据或一次比较最多20个关键词，发现相关搜索词，查看某个关键词对应的商品列表，通过市场、国家和时间段探索Trend Buzz关键词趋势。您还可以查阅在eRank中保存的关键词列表。

对于与您的eRank账户连接的Etsy店铺，您可以查看当前店铺的资料和销售排名，浏览带有eRank清单审计评分的商品列表，分析商品的标签，并查看您跟踪的竞品店铺的近期销售情况。您还可以通过店铺的准确名称查询任意Etsy店铺的公开简介和活跃商品列表。

eRank还提供学习资料、新闻、产品更新信息，以及您账户的套餐和剩余使用量信息。

您可访问的内容取决于您的eRank账户类型。部分数据和每日搜索额度会根据套餐不同而有所差异，当数据在您的套餐中不可用或达到每日限额时，结果会明确提示。其他店铺的信息仅限公开的Etsy数据和eRank研究数据，不会包含其私人订单、客户或账户详情。

当您发起请求时，插件可更改eRank中已连接店铺的激活状态。该插件不会创建、编辑、发布或删除Etsy商品列表，也不会修改Etsy店铺设置。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Keyword statistics for one keyword or up to 20 at once, Related searches and top-ranking listings for a keyword, Trend Buzz keyword trends by marketplace and country, Saved eRank keyword lists, Current shop profile, sales ranks, and listings, Listing Audit grades and tag analysis, Recent sales for tracked competitor shops, Public summaries and listings for any Etsy shop, Active eRank shop selection, eRank learning resources, news, and product updates, Account plan and usage limits

payload.name: Local SEO Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Local SEO Data brings live local search data for any business and market into your conversations.

Check who ranks in Google's local pack, Maps and organic results for a keyword and city; pull a business's Google Business Profile, reviews and Q&A; run local SEO, citation and reputation audits; research local keywords and search volume; compare competitors and backlinks; scan rankings across a geographic grid; and measure how often AI search answers mention a brand. Apple Maps and Bing results are included too.

Built for SEO agencies, marketers and local businesses. Requires a Local SEO Data account; you sign in with it when you connect. Every tool is read-only: Local SEO Data looks up public search and listing data and never changes your Google Business Profile or any other account.
payload.longDescription:
Local SEO Data将任何企业及市场的实时本地搜索数据融入您的对话。

查看针对关键词和城市的Google本地包、地图及自然结果排名；提取企业Google商业资料、评论及问答内容；执行本地SEO、引用资料和声誉审计；研究本地关键词及搜索量；对比竞争对手和反向链接；跨地理网格扫描排名；并衡量AI搜索回答提及品牌频率。Apple Maps和Bing结果也包含在内。

专为SEO代理机构、营销人员和本地企业打造。需要Local SEO Data账户；连接时需使用该账户登录。所有工具均为只读模式：Local SEO Data仅查询公开的搜索和列表数据，不会修改您的Google商业资料或其他任何账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Check Google local pack, Maps and organic rankings, Pull Google Business Profiles, reviews and Q&A, Run local SEO, citation and reputation audits, Research local keywords and search volume, Compare competitors and backlinks, Scan rankings across a geographic grid, Measure brand visibility in AI answers, Look up Apple Maps and Bing listings

payload.name: Rankium
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Rankium is a visibility intelligence platform for websites and online businesses. It lets users connect and inspect their own search, analytics, market, directory, backlink, and technical-site data from sources such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Bing Webmaster Tools, DataForSEO, Firecrawl, and optional visibility providers. Use Rankium to list accessible website projects and companies, read underlying provider measurements, review the Rankium Visibility Score, inspect evidence-grounded reports, action queues, prioritized visibility roadmaps, and directory coverage. Rankium preserves source-specific freshness and reporting semantics rather than treating first-party measurements and third-party estimates as interchangeable. Some refresh and scan operations may contact connected providers and consume Rankium plan quota; read-only tools use data already available to the authenticated Rankium account. Rankium does not publish or modify the user's website through these plugin tools.
payload.longDescription: Rankium 是面向网站和在线企业的可见性智能平台。它允许用户连接并检查来自 Google Search Console、Google Analytics 4、Bing Webmaster Tools、DataForSEO、Firecrawl 以及可选的可见性服务提供商等来源的搜索、分析、市场、目录、反向链接和技术站点数据。通过 Rankium 可以列出可访问的网站项目和企业，查看底层服务商的测量数据，查阅 Rankium 可见性评分，检查基于证据的报告、操作队列、优先级可见性路线图和目录覆盖范围。Rankium 会保留原始数据源的更新频率和报告语义，而非将第一方测量数据与第三方估算数据视为可互换。部分刷新和扫描操作可能需要联系已连接的服务商并消耗 Rankium 计划配额；只读工具则使用已认证 Rankium 账户可用的数据。Rankium 不会通过这些插件工具发布或修改用户网站。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Read website visibility data, Review search and analytics signals, Inspect visibility scores and reports, Prioritize visibility improvements, Check directory coverage

payload.name: 3RD
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
3RD measures how visible your brand is when people ask AI assistants about your market. Connect your 3RD account to ask, in plain language:

- How visible is our brand right now, and how has that changed?
- How do we rank against the competitors we track?
- Which websites and pages do the assistants cite when they answer?
- Which questions do we lack content for?
- What should we do next, according to our plan and the recommended tasks?

The plugin reads the brands, prompts, markets and competitors you already monitor in 3RD; it only shows data your account can access. Numbers cover a stated period, usually the last 30 days. The plugin only reads; it never changes your account.

Monitoring is set up in the 3RD app; new brands and prompts need their first answers collected before results appear.
payload.longDescription:
3RD可衡量当人们向AI助手咨询您的市场时，您的品牌有多大的可见性。
连接您的3RD账户，用自然语言提问：

- 我们的品牌当前可见性如何，这种可见性发生了什么变化？
- 我们在追踪的竞争对手中排名如何？
- 助手回答时引用了哪些网站和页面？
- 我们在哪些问题上缺乏相关内容？
- 根据我们的计划和推荐任务，下一步该做什么？

插件会读取您已在3RD中监控的品牌、提示语、市场和竞争对手；它仅展示您账户可访问的数据。
数据覆盖指定时间段，通常是最近30天。
插件仅用于读取数据，不会更改您的账户。

监控功能在3RD应用中设置；新品牌和提示语需要先收集首次回答后结果才会显示。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Report AI visibility for a brand, Compare a brand with its competitors over time, Show which sources AI assistants cite, Find questions the brand lacks content for, Show the playbook and recommended next tasks

payload.name: DataFluxor
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect DataFluxor to research Google search results and inspect public websites from ChatGPT. Tools cover organic SERP results, autocomplete suggestions, index checks, page metadata, bounded technical SEO crawls, SERP volatility, competitor keyword comparisons, AI Overview visibility, and retained runs. Sign in to your own DataFluxor workspace with OAuth. An existing paid plan and credits are required; each paid tool states its credit cost. Results come from public search and web pages requested by the user. Tool availability follows the workspace plan and permissions.
payload.longDescription:
将DataFluxor连接至ChatGPT，用于研究Google搜索结果并检查公共网站。
工具涵盖自然搜索结果、自动补全建议、索引检测、页面元数据、有限技术SEO爬取、SERP波动性、竞争对手关键词对比、AI摘要可见性及已保存的爬取任务。
通过OAuth登录您自己的DataFluxor工作区。
需要有效的付费计划和信用额度；每个付费工具会标明其信用消耗。
结果来源于用户请求的公共搜索和网页内容。
工具可用性取决于工作区计划和权限配置。

payload.name: Egantic
payload.description: 将Bol的市场数据纳入你的AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Egantic is een analysetool voor verkopers op bol.com: het levert marktdata en analyses over je eigen producten. Elke nacht meet Egantic hoe je producten op bol.com staan: zoekposities per zoekwoord, zichtbaarheid, prijs tegenover concurrenten, reviews, zoekvolumes, advertentiedruk in je markt en de weekanalyse per product. Met deze plugin stel je daar vragen over in gewone taal en krijg je cijfers met meetdag en bron. Alles leest opgeslagen metingen van je eigen Egantic-werkruimte; de plugin wijzigt niets bij bol.com en niets in Egantic. Bedoeld voor verkopers op bol.com met een Egantic-account met minstens één gevolgd product.
payload.longDescription: Egantic是bol.com卖家的分析工具，提供关于您自己产品的市场数据和分析。每晚，Egantic会监测您的产品在bol.com上的表现：按关键词的搜索位置、可见性、与竞争对手的价格对比、评论、搜索量、市场广告压力以及按产品每周分析。通过此插件，您可以以自然语言提出相关问题，并获得带有测量日期和来源的数据。所有数据均来自您自己的Egantic工作区存储的测量记录；插件不会修改bol.com或Egantic中的任何内容。适用于在bol.com上拥有Egantic账户并至少跟踪一个产品的卖家。

payload.name: Petalie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Petalie gets the public numbers of a TikTok account from its username or profile link. It returns the profile (followers, following, total likes, post count), the newest 20 posts with their views, likes, comments, shares, length and caption, and numbers computed from them: the typical views per post, the best and lowest post, how often the account posts, engagement per 1,000 views, and which posts appear to be paid promotion. It adds short notes on what stands out in those numbers and a link to the account's page on petalie.ai.

Use it for your own account or for another public account you want to understand. It reads public data only: it does not watch or analyze the videos themselves, needs no password, has no access to private analytics, and never posts or changes anything. TikTok only, with a daily limit of reads per person.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Get a public TikTok account's profile and recent post numbers, Compare an account's best post with its typical one, Summarize posting frequency and engagement per 1,000 views

payload.name: MarginEdge
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MarginEdge is restaurant back-office software that processes invoices, tracks food costs and inventory, and connects to POS and accounting systems. This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to your MarginEdge data, so owners, operators, chefs and accounting teams can get answers in plain language instead of building reports by hand.

With it, ChatGPT can:
- Look up invoices by date range, vendor or location, down to individual line items
- Track what you pay for a product over time and compare prices across vendors
- Review recipes, ingredients and plate costs, and how recipe costs have changed
- Pull inventory counts and values, and the count sheets behind them
- Read sales and profit-and-loss reports for a single location or a group of locations
- Browse your product catalog, categories, vendors and vendor items

Example questions:
- "Which products went up the most in price from our produce vendor this quarter?"
- "What did we spend on food by category at our downtown location last month?"
- "Which menu recipes are over their target plate cost?"
- "Compare sales across our locations for last week."

Works well for multi-location groups: ChatGPT can roll data up across locations or drill into one.

How it works: sign in with your MarginEdge account. ChatGPT sees only the restaurants and data your account already has access to, and it can't create, change or delete anything in MarginEdge. Access requires a MarginEdge Admin or Franchisee Admin role.
payload.longDescription:
MarginEdge是餐厅后台软件，可处理发票、跟踪食材成本和库存，并连接POS系统和会计系统。该插件为ChatGPT提供对MarginEdge数据的只读访问权限，使店主、运营人员、主厨和财务团队能够通过自然语言获取答案，而非手动制作报表。

通过该插件，ChatGPT可实现以下功能：
- 按日期范围、供应商或门店查找发票，精确到单个明细项
- 跟踪某产品随时间推移的采购价格，并对比不同供应商的价格
- 查看食谱、原料和餐盘成本，以及食谱成本的变化情况
- 提取库存数量和价值，以及对应的库存清单
- 查阅单个门店或多个门店的销售和损益报告
- 浏览产品目录、分类、供应商及供应商商品信息

示例问题：
- "本季度从我们的农产品供应商处价格上涨最多的商品有哪些？"
- "上个月我们在市中心门店的食材分类支出是多少？"
- "哪些菜单食谱的餐盘成本超过目标值？"
- "对比我们各门店上周的销售情况。"

适用于多门店集团：ChatGPT可跨门店汇总数据或深入查看单个门店数据。

使用方式：通过MarginEdge账户登录。
ChatGPT仅能查看您账户已有的餐厅和数据，且无法在MarginEdge中创建、修改或删除任何内容。
访问权限需要MarginEdge管理员或特许经营管理员角色。
